papers.method_zh: 综述了理论概念（如伯格斯矢量、非仿射塑性、振动模式、拓扑不变量），以及近期的数值模拟和实验进展。摘要未具体列出实验手段或计算方法名称。

papers.title: Universal Extraction of Quantum Critical Exponents and Phase Transitions via Tailored Hilbert Space
papers.abstract: Finite-size scaling and the renormalization group form the central toolkit for analyzing quantum phase transitions (QPTs). In this Letter, we introduce a novel Hilbert-space tailoring scheme to probe quantum critical phenomena. Applied to the second-order QPT of the one-dimensional (1D) XY model, our method yields precise critical points and exponents on lattices containing merely 50 unit cells. We further establish the universal applicability of this framework via investigations of the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition in the 1D XXZ chain: critical parameters are recovered with as few as 12 lattice sites. This technique may open an alternative, efficient route to universally characterize QPT across many-body lattice systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Finite-size scaling, renormalization group, Hilbert-space tailoring scheme。；研究对象：量子相变（QPT），具体研究了一维XY模型的二级量子相变和一维XXZ链的Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种新的希尔伯特空间裁剪方案，能够在小尺寸晶格（如50个晶胞的XY模型，12个格点的XXZ链）上精确提取量子临界点和临界指数，证明了该方法的普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种新的希尔伯特空间裁剪方案，能够在小尺寸晶格（如50个晶胞的XY模型，12个格点的XXZ链）上精确提取量子临界点和临界指数，证明了该方法的普适性。；创新点：提出了一种替代传统有限尺寸标度分析的新方案，该方案能够在极小的系统尺寸下（如12个格点）准确恢复BKT相变的临界参数，为普适地表征多体晶格系统中的量子相变提供了一条高效的新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：有限尺寸标度理论和重整化群。具体方法：引入了一种新颖的“希尔伯特空间裁剪方案”（Hilbert-space tailoring scheme），通过裁剪希尔伯特空间来探测量子临界现象。

papers.title: The effect of pressure on the splitting in $^3$He in nematic aerogel
papers.abstract: Here, we present the results of an investigation of how the pressure affects the splitting of the superfluid transition temperature in $^3$He in anisotropic aerogel. It is well known that boundary conditions significantly influence the properties of superfluid phases in aerogel. When aerogel strands are coated with a $^4$He layer in magnetic field, new phases, such as the polar, polar-distorted A (DA), polar-distorted B (DB), and $β$ phases, become energetically favorable. In contrast, without this coating, the system tends to favor phases resembling the bulk A, B, and A$_1$ phases. Our earlier results showed a nonlinear dependence of the superfluid transition temperature splitting in pure $^3$He, but the range of nonlinearity did not match the theoretical predictions based on magnetic scattering effects. To further investigate this discrepancy, we performed measurements of the splitting under varying pressures for both pure $^3$He and with $^4$He coverage of the aerogel strands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“measurements”（测量）、“results of an investigation”（研究结果）。；研究对象：超流³He在向列型气凝胶中的超流转变温度劈裂现象，以及压力对该劈裂的影响。具体涉及纯³He和涂覆⁴He层的气凝胶两种体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在纯³He中，超流转变温度劈裂随压力呈非线性依赖，但该非线性范围与基于磁散射效应的理论预测不符；通过测量不同压力下纯³He和⁴He覆盖气凝胶的劈裂，进一步探究这一差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在纯³He中，超流转变温度劈裂随压力呈非线性依赖，但该非线性范围与基于磁散射效应的理论预测不符；通过测量不同压力下纯³He和⁴He覆盖气凝胶的劈裂，进一步探究这一差异。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量：在不同压力下测量超流转变温度的劈裂，对比纯³He与⁴He覆盖气凝胶两种情形。

papers.title: Proximity-Induced Spin Reorientation in Monolayer CrI$_3$ on Hexagonal WTe$_2$
papers.abstract: Magnetic anisotropy controls the orientation and thermal stability of two-dimensional magnetic order. Predicting proximity-induced changes in anisotropy requires linking the electronic structure to microscopic magnetic interactions and finite-temperature behavior. Here we study monolayer CrI$_3$ on hexagonal WTe$_2$ using a first-principles-to-finite-temperature workflow centered on relativistic spin-Hamiltonian mapping. We find that WTe$_2$ reorients the CrI$_3$ magnetization from out-of-plane to in-plane and substantially enhances the magnetic ordering scale within the extracted spin models. Analysis of the extracted spin Hamiltonians shows that the reorientation is driven by a substrate-induced change in the balance between symmetric anisotropic exchange and onsite anisotropy. We establish a transferable workflow for proximity-controlled magnetism in two-dimensional van der Waals heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：first-principles-to-finite-temperature workflow、relativistic spin-Hamiltonian mapping、extracted spin models。；研究对象：单层CrI₃放置在六方WTe₂上形成的范德华异质结，具体研究邻近效应导致的磁各向异性变化和磁有序温度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: WTe₂衬底将单层CrI₃的磁化方向从面外（out-of-plane）重新取向为面内（in-plane），并显著提升了自旋模型中的磁有序温度尺度。该重取向由衬底诱导的对称各向异性交换作用与局域各向异性之间的平衡变化驱动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：WTe₂衬底将单层CrI₃的磁化方向从面外（out-of-plane）重新取向为面内（in-plane），并显著提升了自旋模型中的磁有序温度尺度。该重取向由衬底诱导的对称各向异性交换作用与局域各向异性之间的平衡变化驱动。；创新点：建立了一个可迁移的工作流，用于预测和解释范德华异质结中邻近效应控制的磁性（包括磁各向异性重取向和磁有序温度增强），并明确区分了对称各向异性交换与局域各向异性在重取向中的不同作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算结合有限温度工作流，核心是相对论自旋哈密顿量映射（relativistic spin-Hamiltonian mapping），从电子结构提取微观磁相互作用参数，并分析有限温度行为。

papers.title: Broadband molecular dynamics simulation of fluid inertial effects in confined Brownian motion
papers.abstract: Hydrodynamic memory governs Brownian motion over a broad range of timescales, from acoustic wave propagation at short times to diffusive relaxation at long times. While confinement-induced corrections to Brownian diffusion are well established, how confinement modifies the full hydrodynamic response remains less explored. In this Letter, we use molecular-dynamics simulations of a neutrally buoyant colloidal particle in an explicit solvent to resolve the velocity autocorrelation function across a broad hydrodynamic spectrum. In the bulk, the simulations recover compressibility, added mass, the hydrodynamic long-time tail, and Stokes-Einstein diffusion without adjustable parameters. Near a rigid wall, the velocity correlations become anisotropic, their algebraic tails are modified, and the diffusion coefficients are reduced. Most importantly, the short-time dynamics reveals a pronounced enhancement of the effective added mass as the wall is approached. As such, the velocity autocorrelation function appears as a central quantity to bridge the zero-frequency mobility and the high-frequency inertial behaviour of a confined Brownian particle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：molecular-dynamics simulations、velocity autocorrelation function、without adjustable parameters）；研究对象：受限布朗运动中流体惯性效应，具体为中性浮力胶体粒子在显式溶剂中靠近刚性壁时的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 靠近刚性壁时，速度自相关函数变得各向异性，其代数尾被修正，扩散系数降低；短时动力学显示有效附加质量随壁面接近而显著增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：靠近刚性壁时，速度自相关函数变得各向异性，其代数尾被修正，扩散系数降低；短时动力学显示有效附加质量随壁面接近而显著增强。；创新点：通过无可调参数的分子动力学模拟，首次系统揭示了受限条件下从短时声波传播到长时扩散弛豫的完整流体动力学响应，特别是壁面附近短时有效附加质量的增强效应。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟（molecular-dynamics simulations），模拟中性浮力胶体粒子在显式溶剂中的运动，解析速度自相关函数覆盖宽频流体动力学谱。

papers.title: Evaluating the solution performance of the augmented Lagrangian function on Ising machines
papers.abstract: We apply the augmented Lagrangian function (ALF) as a formulation for Ising machines and evaluate its performance by time-to-epsilon (\mathrm{TT\varepsilon}). The ALF has been well studied in continuous optimization for its numerical stability and convergence, and its advantage over the penalty function formulation is demonstrated here through the following results. Using the quadratic knapsack problem as a benchmark, we examine the dependence of \mathrm{TT\varepsilon} on the hyperparameters μand λ. The augmented Lagrangian formulation reduces \mathrm{TT\varepsilon} by roughly an order of magnitude compared with the penalty function formulation, keeping μsmall while obtaining feasible solutions and, for representative parameter settings, reaching high-precision solutions earlier in the search. These findings indicate that the augmented Lagrangian function is a promising formulation for improving the solution performance of Ising machines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“formulation”、“evaluate its performance”、“benchmark”、“hyperparameters”。；研究对象：Ising 机（Ising machines）在求解组合优化问题时的性能，具体以二次背包问题（quadratic knapsack problem）为基准测试体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 增广拉格朗日函数（ALF）作为Ising机的求解公式，相比传统的罚函数公式，可将求解时间（time-to-epsilon, TTε）降低约一个数量级，且能在保持较小超参数μ的同时获得可行解，并在搜索早期达到高精度解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：增广拉格朗日函数（ALF）作为Ising机的求解公式，相比传统的罚函数公式，可将求解时间（time-to-epsilon, TTε）降低约一个数量级，且能在保持较小超参数μ的同时获得可行解，并在搜索早期达到高精度解。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用增广拉格朗日函数（ALF）作为Ising机的目标函数形式，通过时间-精度指标（TTε）评估性能，并以二次背包问题为基准，系统考察超参数μ和λ对TTε的依赖关系。

papers.title: One-dimensional self-organization of water molecules in proton conducting Andersson-Wadsley titanates
papers.abstract: Layered alkali titanates with M 2 Ti 2 O 5 chemical formula (MTO, M=K,Rb) belonging to the Andersson-Wadsley perovskite family spontaneously incorporate water to form MTO.(H 2 O) x compounds, which exhibit superionic conductivity. At very low hydration x, scanning electron microscopy evidences one-dimensional heterogeneous patterns oriented along ___ b that are arranged in an orderly manner. At higher hydration, the material is observed to spontaneously exfoliate by creating (001) surfaces. Simulations carried out using Density Functional Theory reveal an ordered arrangement of the guest water molecules in Rb 2 Ti 2 O 5 , with strong hydrogen bonds between the water molecules and the apical oxygen of the host crystal. At low hydration x, the water molecules form self-organized one dimensional (1D) double chains along ___ b. Further increase of the water content leads to the creation of hydrated (001)-surfaces that are made of densely packed water chains in agreement with the infrared spectroscopy measurements. Rb 2 Ti 2 O 5 exhibits highly anisotropic proton conductivity, with respect to the crystal orientation, with super-ionic conductivity along ___ b reaching 3 mS/cm at room temperature after hydration. The combined observations and simulations suggest that these water chains are thus at the root of fast proton conduction, which is likely powered by a Grotthuss-like mechanism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时提及“scanning electron microscopy”“infrared spectroscopy”等实验手段，以及“Density Functional Theory”计算模拟。；研究对象：安德森-沃兹利（Andersson-Wadsley）家族层状碱金属钛酸盐M₂Ti₂O₅（M=K,Rb）及其水合物MTO·(H₂O)ₓ，重点研究其中水分子的一维自组织行为及其与质子超离子导电性的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低水合度下，水分子在Rb₂Ti₂O₅中沿b轴自组织形成一维双链结构；这些水链是室温下沿b轴方向超离子导电性（电导率达3 mS/cm）的根源，其传导机制很可能基于Grotthuss型质子跳跃。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低水合度下，水分子在Rb₂Ti₂O₅中沿b轴自组织形成一维双链结构；这些水链是室温下沿b轴方向超离子导电性（电导率达3 mS/cm）的根源，其传导机制很可能基于Grotthuss型质子跳跃。；创新点：首次在安德森-沃兹利钛酸盐中观察到水分子沿特定晶向（b轴）的一维自组织双链结构，并将这种有序水链与超离子导电性直接关联，提出Grotthuss机制驱动的质子传导模型。
papers.method_zh: 扫描电子显微镜（SEM）观察水合诱导的形貌与剥离；红外光谱测量水链结构；密度泛函理论（DFT）模拟水分子排列与氢键作用；各向异性质子电导率测量。

papers.title: Nonradiative Multiphonon Model of Deep-Level Transient Spectroscopy: Beyond Henry-Lang Model
papers.abstract: Deep-level transient spectroscopy (DLTS) is a key experimental method for defect characterization, yet its analysis remains controversial, and the two widely used models developed by Henry and Lang are conflicting. We show that the Henry-Lang model is valid only under the Condon approximation, as well as high-temperature and strong electron-phonon coupling approximations, which cause incorrect temperature dependence of carrier emission and capture. Here we develop a rigorous nonradiative multiphonon (NMP) model, and demonstrate that the temperature dependence is governed predominantly by effective phonons with large phonon wavefunction overlap and high thermal occupation. The effective phonons are strongly correlated with lattice relaxation.The neglect of this correlation in existing DLTS models introduces substantial errors when they are used to fit DLTS-measured emission rates. Our comparison for 21 different defects in 12 semiconductors, including Si, SiC and Ga$_2$O$_3$, shows that the Henry-Lang model gives a completely different temperature dependence of carrier capture cross section from that obtained using the rigorous NMP model, with errors reaching up to six orders of magnitude at room temperature. Our study highlights the necessity of revisiting previous DLTS analysis studies using the rigorous NMP model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“develop a rigorous nonradiative multiphonon (NMP) model”、“show that”、“demonstrate”，属于理论建模与模型对比分析。；研究对象：深能级瞬态谱（DLTS）技术中载流子发射与俘获的温度依赖性问题，具体涉及Si、SiC和Ga₂O₃等12种半导体中的21种不同缺陷。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 现有Henry-Lang模型仅在Condon近似、高温和强电子-声子耦合近似下成立，导致载流子发射与俘获的温度依赖性错误；新发展的严格非辐射多声子（NMP）模型表明，温度依赖性主要由具有大波函数重叠和高热占据的有效声子主导，且有效声子与晶格弛豫强相关。对比显示，Henry-Lang模型在室温下对载流子俘获截面的误差可达六个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：现有Henry-Lang模型仅在Condon近似、高温和强电子-声子耦合近似下成立，导致载流子发射与俘获的温度依赖性错误；新发展的严格非辐射多声子（NMP）模型表明，温度依赖性主要由具有大波函数重叠和高热占据的有效声子主导，且有效声子与晶格弛豫强相关。对比显示，Henry-Lang模型在室温下对载流子俘获截面的误差可达六个数量级。；创新点：首次指出Henry-Lang模型因忽略有效声子与晶格弛豫的强相关性而引入系统性误差，并提出了超越该模型的严格NMP理论框架，强调需用该模型重新审视以往的DLTS分析结果。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与模型对比。具体包括：1）建立严格的非辐射多声子（NMP）模型；2）将NMP模型与Henry-Lang模型进行解析对比；3）对12种半导体中21种缺陷的DLTS发射率数据进行拟合与误差分析。

papers.title: Band offsets and stability of WSe$_2$/RuCl$_3$ van der Waals charge-transfer contacts
papers.abstract: The layered Mott insulator $α$-RuCl$_3$ induces degenerate hole-doping in two-dimensional semiconductors due to its large electron affinity, making it a promising charge-transfer material for establishing ohmic contacts in electronic devices. In order to assess the applicability and guide the design of devices incorporating RuCl$_3$ it is critical to determine the electronic structure and robustness of the band offsets that underpin the transport properties of semiconductors in contact with RuCl$_3$. Here, we apply micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to determine the electronic structure of single-layer WSe$_2$ contacted to RuCl$_3$ on hexagonal boron nitride substrates. We find that formation of a functioning WSe$_2$/RuCl$_3$ contact leads to a valence band shift of $(0.68 \pm 0.05)$ eV towards the Fermi energy in WSe$_2$. The charge transfer effect is challenging to observe as it depends sensitively on fabrication conditions such as solvent exposure, quality of interface encapsulation and heating of RuCl$_3$, imposing strict requirements on device design to attain high-quality contacts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy”（微聚焦角分辨光电子能谱）。；研究对象：WSe₂/RuCl₃ 范德华异质结中的电荷转移接触，具体为单层WSe₂与层状Mott绝缘体α-RuCl₃形成的界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: WSe₂/RuCl₃接触形成后，WSe₂的价带向费米能级移动了(0.68 ± 0.05) eV，表明RuCl₃可诱导WSe₂产生空穴掺杂。但该电荷转移效应强烈依赖于制备条件（如溶剂暴露、界面封装质量、RuCl₃加热处理），对器件设计提出严格要求。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：WSe₂/RuCl₃接触形成后，WSe₂的价带向费米能级移动了(0.68 ± 0.05) eV，表明RuCl₃可诱导WSe₂产生空穴掺杂。但该电荷转移效应强烈依赖于制备条件（如溶剂暴露、界面封装质量、RuCl₃加热处理），对器件设计提出严格要求。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 微聚焦角分辨光电子能谱（micro-ARPES），结合六方氮化硼（hBN）衬底上的单层WSe₂/RuCl₃异质结样品制备。

papers.title: Gate-Controlled Spin Qubits in Confined Altermagnets
papers.abstract: We propose gate-defined spin qubits in electrostatically confined altermagnetic quantum dots. Elliptical confinement of the $d$-wave altermagnetic structure produces a low-energy doublet with opposite spin polarization. For the range of parameters used here, the qubit states energy gap lies in the microwave range while the leakage gap remains in the meV range. Even without spin-orbit coupling, time-dependent simulations show that a phase-controlled quadrupolar gate drive about a fixed bias point implements $X_{π/2}$ and $X_π$ rotations by resonantly modulating the confinement anisotropy. We extend the study to two-qubits using a double quantum dot. We show that the double quantum dot spectrum can be cleanly projected onto isolated quantum dot product states with a nonzero nonlocal Pauli block in the effective logical two-qubit Hamiltonian. Resonant central-barrier modulation then drives the logical two-qubit component close to a maximally entangled state. These calculations show anisotropic altermagnetic quantum dots as a route to locally gate-controlled spin qubits without requiring spin-orbit coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：propose、time-dependent simulations、projected onto、effective Hamiltonian）；研究对象：静电约束下的交变磁（altermagnetic）量子点中的门控自旋量子比特。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过椭圆约束d波交变磁结构，可在无自旋-轨道耦合条件下实现单量子比特的X_{π/2}和X_π旋转，以及双量子点中接近最大纠缠态的逻辑两量子比特操作。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过椭圆约束d波交变磁结构，可在无自旋-轨道耦合条件下实现单量子比特的X_{π/2}和X_π旋转，以及双量子点中接近最大纠缠态的逻辑两量子比特操作。；创新点：提出利用交变磁量子点的各向异性实现局部门控自旋量子比特，无需依赖自旋-轨道耦合，为自旋量子比特的局域电控提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与含时模拟：采用静电约束下的交变磁量子点模型，通过相位控制四极门驱动调制约束各向异性，并利用双量子点谱投影到孤立量子点乘积态的方法提取有效两量子比特哈密顿量。

papers.title: Fluctuation exchange study on the electron-hole asymmetry of the superconductivity across 1/3 filling in the trilayer Hubbard model
papers.abstract: We study within the fluctuation exchange approximation the trilayer Hubbard model where three layers of the Hubbard model are coupled by large interlayer hoppings so that the overlap of the bonding, nonbonding, and antibonding bands is relatively small. We pay special attention to the band fillings close to 1/3, for which the bonding and nonbonding bands as a whole are close to half filling. For relatively small values of the onsite $U$, superconductivity roughly exhibits electron-hole symmetric behavior, as expected for a nearly half-filled two-band system. By contrast, an asymmetry appears when $U$ becomes large, where superconductivity is more favored in the hole-doped regime, i.e., in the regime where electrons are removed from 1/3 filling. We attribute this asymmetry to the asymmetric renormalization of the bonding, nonbonding, and antibonding bands when $U$ is large.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：fluctuation exchange approximation（涨落交换近似）、trilayer Hubbard model（三层哈伯德模型）。；研究对象：三层哈伯德模型，具体关注该模型中接近1/3填充（即键合带与非键合带整体接近半填充）时的超导电性，以及电子-空穴掺杂不对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在小在位库仑相互作用U下，超导电性近似呈现电子-空穴对称行为；当U增大时，出现不对称性，空穴掺杂（即从1/3填充移除电子）更有利于超导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在小在位库仑相互作用U下，超导电性近似呈现电子-空穴对称行为；当U增大时，出现不对称性，空穴掺杂（即从1/3填充移除电子）更有利于超导。；创新点：揭示了在强关联（大U）条件下，三层哈伯德模型中超导电性在1/3填充附近的电子-空穴不对称性，并将其归因于键合带、非键合带和反键合带的不对称重整化。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用涨落交换近似（fluctuation exchange approximation）对三层哈伯德模型进行理论计算分析。

papers.title: Density-wave order enhances the phonon thermal Hall effect in a trilayer nickelate
papers.abstract: Ruddlesden--Popper nickelates have emerged as a promising platform for high-temperature superconductivity, yet the role of lattice degrees of freedom in their correlated normal state remains largely unexplored. Here, we report the observation of a finite phonon thermal Hall effect in the trilayer nickelate La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$ at ambient pressure. Remarkably, the thermal Hall response is strongly enhanced below the density-wave transition at $T^*\approx140$ K, exhibiting two distinct plateaus in the thermal Hall resistivity. The characteristic energy scale extracted from the thermal Hall response ($\sim4.1$ meV) closely matches the magnon--phonon crossing span energy ($\sim3.2$ meV), pointing to magnon--phonon hybridization as the primary mechanism enhancing the thermal Hall effect. These results provide new insight into the interplay between lattice and spin excitations in nickelates, with implications for understanding both their superconductivity and the multiple possible origins of insulating thermal Hall signals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：observation, report, thermal Hall effect, ambient pressure。；研究对象：三层镍氧化物 La₄Ni₃O₁₀ 中的声子热霍尔效应，以及密度波序对其的增强作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在环境压力下，三层镍酸盐 La₄Ni₃O₁₀ 中观测到有限的声子热霍尔效应，且该效应在密度波转变温度（约140 K）以下显著增强，热霍尔电阻率呈现两个不同的平台。增强机制主要源于磁振子-声子杂化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在环境压力下，三层镍酸盐 La₄Ni₃O₁₀ 中观测到有限的声子热霍尔效应，且该效应在密度波转变温度（约140 K）以下显著增强，热霍尔电阻率呈现两个不同的平台。增强机制主要源于磁振子-声子杂化。；创新点：首次在Ruddlesden-Popper镍酸盐中观测到声子热霍尔效应，并发现密度波序可显著增强该效应，揭示了晶格与自旋激发之间的相互作用在镍酸盐正常态中的关键角色。
papers.method_zh: 热霍尔效应测量（thermal Hall effect measurement），通过分析热霍尔电阻率随温度的变化提取特征能量尺度（约4.1 meV），并与磁振子-声子交叉跨越能量（约3.2 meV）进行对比。

papers.title: Multiple phases in K2Cr3As3: a playground for manipulating topological superconductivity
papers.abstract: Spin-triplet topological superconductors are rare but of fundamental interest as they can host Majorana bound states that can be used in fault-tolerant quantum computing. Recent efforts have been devoted to searching for spin-triplet states in U-based compounds, but these materials have a low transition temperature (Tc) and coexisting competing orders, which creates significant experimental challenges and often leads to contradictory conclusions. The Cr-based candidate K2Cr3As3 offers a promising alternative: it has a much higher Tc of 6.2 K and no magnetic order. Here we report a hallmark signature of spin-triplet superconductivity arising from the internal spin degrees of freedom via nuclear magnetic resonance measurements, and demonstrate the high tunability of the topological phases. We discovered three distinct superconducting phases and revealed the evolution of the paired-spins direction (d(k)-vector). At low magnetic fields, K2Cr3As3 evolves from a helical (Phase A) to a chiral state (Phase B) with a rotation of the d(k)-vector from in-plane to out-of-plane direction upon cooling, although both phases have point nodes in the gap. A linenodal gap is realized in the high-field Phase C, where the d(k)-vector lies in the basal plane. These findings establish K2Cr3As3 as a model spin-triplet superconductor and a promising platform for manipulating topological phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“via nuclear magnetic resonance measurements”（核磁共振测量）。；研究对象：Cr基超导体K₂Cr₃As₃，具体研究其自旋三重态超导相及拓扑超导相的可调控性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过核磁共振测量，发现K₂Cr₃As₃中存在三种不同的超导相（螺旋态A、手性态B、高场线节点态C），并揭示了配对自旋方向（d(k)-矢量）随温度和磁场的演化，确立了该材料作为自旋三重态超导体的模型体系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过核磁共振测量，发现K₂Cr₃As₃中存在三种不同的超导相（螺旋态A、手性态B、高场线节点态C），并揭示了配对自旋方向（d(k)-矢量）随温度和磁场的演化，确立了该材料作为自旋三重态超导体的模型体系。；创新点：首次在Cr基超导体中通过实验观测到自旋三重态超导的标志性特征，并系统揭示了多个拓扑超导相及其d(k)-矢量的演化，为操控拓扑超导相提供了可调平台。
papers.method_zh: 核磁共振（NMR）测量，用于探测内部自旋自由度的特征信号，并结合磁场和温度调控来区分不同超导相。

papers.title: Low-temperature magnetic-field-driven thermal oscillator based on metal-superconductor joint
papers.abstract: Thermal control is one of the important technologies for fundamental science and thermal management. Among them, thermal oscillators have been in demands in the field of materials science and device application. In general, flexible frequency, amplitude, and waveform are needed for useful thermal oscillator, and the stability of the average temperature is also highly required. However, thermal oscillators based on an AC-current-driven heater require complicated control of input power to achieve the above-mentioned flexibility and stability of the outputs. Here, we demonstrate that magnetically-driven thermal oscillators fabricated using a metal-superconductor (Cu-Pb) joint achieve those requirements easily by tuning the applied magnetic field (H). A DC-current-driven heater is attached on the metal (Cu) side, and the superconductor (Pb) edge is attached to thermal bath. We use a sharp and huge change in thermal conductivity at the superconducting transition of the Pb wire to generate thermal oscillation at the Cu-wire side. A sine-shaped thermal oscillation with an amplitude of 180 mK and a frequency of 0.17 Hz is observed with highly stable average temperature. Furthermore, a larger amplitude is achieved in a square-shaped oscillation with a larger H amplitude. Our thermal oscillator with temperature stability, large amplitude, and relatively high frequency will work as a flexible AC heat source at cryogenic temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、fabricated、observed、experiment。；研究对象：基于金属-超导体（Cu-Pb）接合点制成的磁驱动热振荡器，具体研究其在外加磁场下的热振荡行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节外加磁场，利用超导铅线在超导转变处热导率的急剧巨大变化，在铜线侧实现了振幅180 mK、频率0.17 Hz的正弦形热振荡，且平均温度高度稳定；增大磁场振幅还可获得更大振幅的方波形振荡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节外加磁场，利用超导铅线在超导转变处热导率的急剧巨大变化，在铜线侧实现了振幅180 mK、频率0.17 Hz的正弦形热振荡，且平均温度高度稳定；增大磁场振幅还可获得更大振幅的方波形振荡。；创新点：与需要复杂输入功率控制的交流电流驱动热振荡器不同，该工作仅通过调节外加磁场即可灵活实现热振荡的频率、振幅和波形，同时保持平均温度的高度稳定性。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备了Cu-Pb接合器件，在铜侧安装直流电流驱动的加热器，铅侧边缘连接热沉；通过施加可调磁场（H）驱动热振荡，测量铜线侧的温度振荡波形、振幅和频率。

papers.title: Reversible non-equilibrium phase transformation in amorphous germanium
papers.abstract: First principles molecular dynamics simulations of germanium reveal a reversible liquid-glass transition below the equilibrium melting point with a wide hysteresis loop. Direct calculation of the liquid and amorphous state free energies, enabled by absolute entropy calculations, verify that the transition is first order in character between two metastable phases. These results lend credence to models of explosive recrystallization from amorphous Ge thin films, through a metastable liquid state and finally reaching the low temperature crystalline structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first principles molecular dynamics simulations（第一性原理分子动力学模拟）、direct calculation of free energies（自由能直接计算）、absolute entropy calculations（绝对熵计算）。；研究对象：非晶锗（amorphous germanium）中的可逆非平衡相变，具体为液态与非晶态之间的玻璃化转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在平衡熔点以下，锗存在一个可逆的液-玻璃转变，该转变具有宽的滞后回线，且为两个亚稳态之间的一级相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在平衡熔点以下，锗存在一个可逆的液-玻璃转变，该转变具有宽的滞后回线，且为两个亚稳态之间的一级相变。；创新点：通过直接计算亚稳态自由能，首次从热力学上证实了非晶锗中液-玻璃转变是一级相变，为解释非晶锗薄膜的爆炸性再结晶模型提供了理论支持。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理分子动力学模拟，并通过绝对熵计算直接得到液态和非晶态的自由能，从而验证相变的一级特征。

papers.title: Two-Dimensional Phase Transitions in Classical Systems: 60 Years after the Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner Theorem
papers.abstract: In 1966, Hohenberg, Mermin and Wagner proved that long-wavelength fluctuations destabilize the long-range order of continuous symmetry in two-dimensional (2D) systems. Later in the 1970s, Berezinskii, Kosterlitz and Thouless developed the BKT theory describing an unconventional phase transition between quasi-long-range and short-range order in 2D systems driven by the binding-unbinding of topological defects, which has become a fundamental topic in statistical mechanics, condensed matter physics, and soft matter physics. One of the most important applications of the BKT theory is the melting of 2D crystals, whose mechanisms are not yet fully understood. Recently, this topic has been extended to the area of active matter, where the non-equilibrium nature leads to novel phenomena that deviate from the Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner theorem. In this review, we first focus on the recent theoretical and computational progress in the 2D melting problem in passive systems, and then summarize the inspiring results obtained from non-equilibrium systems. The review closes with comments on several promising directions for predicting 2D melting scenarios and for understanding the non-equilibrium nature in 2D active matter systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（综述）。关键词：review、theoretical and computational progress、summarize。；研究对象：二维经典系统中的相变，特别是二维晶体熔化问题，以及主动物质（非平衡系统）中的二维相变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 综述了自Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner定理（1966年）和BKT理论（1970年代）以来，二维系统中由拓扑缺陷束缚-解束缚驱动的非常规相变（准长程序与短程序之间）的最新理论进展，并指出非平衡主动物质中出现了偏离该定理的新奇现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：综述了自Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner定理（1966年）和BKT理论（1970年代）以来，二维系统中由拓扑缺陷束缚-解束缚驱动的非常规相变（准长程序与短程序之间）的最新理论进展，并指出非平衡主动物质中出现了偏离该定理的新奇现象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该综述主要创新在于系统梳理了被动系统中二维熔化问题的最新理论与计算进展，并首次将非平衡主动物质系统中偏离Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner定理的新奇结果纳入统一讨论，最后指出了预测二维熔化场景和理解非平衡本质的若干有前景方向。
papers.method_zh: 理论综述与计算进展总结。具体涉及：BKT理论框架、二维晶体熔化机制的理论与计算研究、非平衡主动物质系统的数值模拟与理论分析。

papers.title: A 35B Hybrid-Attention Mixture-of-Experts Model on a 6GB 2011 GPU: Hand-Written 4-bit CUDA Inference for Fermi
papers.abstract: We report end-to-end inference of \textbf{Qwen3.6-35B-A3B} -- a 35-billion-parameter, $\sim$3B-active Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with a hybrid gated-delta-net / full-attention backbone -- on a \textbf{2011 NVIDIA Tesla C2075} (Fermi, compute capability \smtwenty, 6\,GB), a GPU that predates tensor cores, native FP16 arithmetic, the \texttt{DP4A} integer dot-product instruction, and support in every modern CUDA toolchain. Because the 4-bit model ($\approx$10.5\,GB) is roughly twice the device memory, we adopt a \emph{hybrid} execution strategy: the GPU performs batched prompt \emph{prefill} with expert weights streamed layer-by-layer from host RAM, while \emph{decode} runs on the host CPU using a hand-written W4A8 integer GEMV built on the SSSE3 \texttt{pmaddubsw} instruction. The entire engine -- GEMM, hybrid-attention recurrence, MoE routing, and a from-scratch vision tower -- is written by hand for \smtwenty{} and compiled with the legacy CUDA 8.0 toolchain. On a 947-token prompt we reduce prefill latency from 57.2\,s to 37.5\,s ($-34\%$) through expert pinning, single-pass prefill, and NUMA interleaving, and we raise decode throughput from 2.8 to 8.6\,\tps{} ($\approx 3\times$) with the integer-SIMD kernel. A position-indexed snapshot cache for the recurrent (gated-delta-net) state restores prefix reuse on a recurrent architecture, cutting a repeated 78\,s prefill to 0.5\,s. We also report a set of \emph{negative} results -- offloading the language-model head to the idle GPU, hyper-threading, and three GPU-kernel rewrites all fail to help -- % which together pin down the practical floor of this hardware. Our aim is not a speed record but a careful account of what it takes, and where the walls are, to run a contemporary frontier-class MoE on fourteen-year-old silicon.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验/工程实现）。判断依据：论文报告了在特定老旧硬件（2011年GPU）上运行现代大模型的具体工程实现、性能优化和基准测试，属于系统实现与性能分析工作。；研究对象：论文研究的对象是**Qwen3.6-35B-A3B**，一个具有约350亿总参数、约30亿激活参数的混合专家（MoE）大语言模型，其骨干网络为混合门控-增量网络（gated-delta-net）与全注意力机制。研究聚焦于如何在该模型上进行推理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过手写4-bit CUDA内核和混合执行策略（GPU预填充+CPU解码），成功在2011年的老旧GPU（6GB显存）上运行了远超其显存容量的35B参数MoE模型，并实现了显著的性能提升：预填充延迟降低34%，解码吞吐量提升约3倍。同时，论文报告了一系列失败的优化尝试，揭示了该硬件平台的性能极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过手写4-bit CUDA内核和混合执行策略（GPU预填充+CPU解码），成功在2011年的老旧GPU（6GB显存）上运行了远超其显存容量的35B参数MoE模型，并实现了显著的性能提升：预填充延迟降低34%，解码吞吐量提升约3倍。同时，论文报告了一系列失败的优化尝试，揭示了该硬件平台的性能极限。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，主要创新点在于：**首次在如此老旧（2011年，无张量核心、无原生FP16、无DP4A指令）且显存远小于模型权重的GPU上，通过极致的底层手工优化和混合计算策略，成功运行了当代前沿的MoE大模型，并系统性地报告了成功与失败的优化经验，为在极端受限硬件上运行大模型提供了宝贵的工程实践参考。**
papers.method_zh: 具体方法包括：

papers.title: Probing the pairing symmetry of moiré graphene superconductors
papers.abstract: The pairing symmetry of magic-angle moiré graphene is a fundamental question that remains unresolved. Combining experimental and theoretical inputs, we constrain the superconducting order parameters that can emerge from the incommensurate Kekulé spiral (IKS) normal state on the hole-doped side of $ν= -2$. Imposing the additional experimental constraint of nodal superconductivity, we are left with the task of distinguishing between singlet or triplet pairing, and of determining the d-vector in the latter case. We propose definitive tests to identify the pairing symmetry based on two classes of experiments using the response of the superconducting state to Zeeman field orientation. The first set of predictions is for spectroscopic and thermodynamic measurements sensitive to low-energy excitations near the nodes. The second set is for phase-sensitive measurements of topologically protected Andreev bound states near boundaries, whose spectroscopy is shown to provide a smoking gun signature of the pairing symmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（结合实验输入）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Combining experimental and theoretical inputs”，并基于实验约束（如节点超导）进行理论分析，提出实验预测。；研究对象：魔角莫尔石墨烯超导体，具体为在空穴掺杂侧ν=-2附近、由非公度Kekulé螺旋（IKS）正常态产生的超导配对对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在实验约束（节点超导）下，需区分单重态或三重态配对，并确定后者的d矢量；通过超导态对塞曼场方向的响应，提出了两类决定性实验来识别配对对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在实验约束（节点超导）下，需区分单重态或三重态配对，并确定后者的d矢量；通过超导态对塞曼场方向的响应，提出了两类决定性实验来识别配对对称性。；创新点：提出了通过塞曼场方向响应区分配对对称性的明确实验方案，特别是利用边界附近拓扑保护的Andreev束缚态光谱作为“确凿证据”（smoking gun signature）来识别配对对称性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合实验约束：利用非公度Kekulé螺旋（IKS）正常态模型，施加节点超导的实验约束，分析超导序参量；提出基于塞曼场方向响应的光谱/热力学测量（低能激发）和相位敏感测量（拓扑保护的Andreev束缚态）作为鉴别手段。

papers.title: Observation of even-denominator fractional quantum Hall states at $ν= 3/4$ and 5/4 in the lowest Landau level
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional electron systems (2DESs) confined to wide GaAs quantum wells provide a unique platform to study exotic fractional quantum Hall states (FQHSs) because the 2DES has a bilayer charge distribution with significant interlayer tunneling. Precise control over the 2DES density allows the tuning of the interlayer tunneling over a wide range. Here, we present our discovery of new even-denominator FQHSs in the lowest Landau level (orbital index \textit{N} = 0) at filling factors $ν= 3/4$ and 5/4 in an ultrahigh-quality 2DES confined to a 72.5-nm-wide GaAs quantum well. The ground states at $ν= 3/4$ and 5/4 both evolve from composite fermion Fermi seas to FQHSs as the density is raised so that interlayer tunneling is sufficiently reduced and the 2DES becomes two-component, signaled by the behavior of the FQHSs flanking $ν= 3/4$ and 5/4. The two-component nature of the $ν=3/4$ and 5/4 FQHSs is also evident from their extreme sensitivity to the bilayer charge distribution symmetry: both states disappear quickly when the charge distribution is made asymmetric by only $\simeq 2\%$. We find a natural explanation for the 3/4 and 5/4 FQHSs in terms of two states linked by particle-hole symmetry, and using the Scarola-Jain bilayer composite fermion framework which is a generalization of the well-known, two-component, Halperin state ($Ψ_{331}$ state). Our observations elucidate the crucial role of competing energy and length scales in wide quantum wells in stabilizing new ground states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“present our discovery”“signaled by the behavior of the FQHSs”“extreme sensitivity”等实验观测和调控描述，属于实验发现。；研究对象：宽GaAs量子阱中二维电子系统（2DES）在最低朗道能级（N=0）下的偶数分母分数量子霍尔态（FQHSs），具体为填充因子ν=3/4和5/4的态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超高质量、72.5 nm宽GaAs量子阱中，首次在最低朗道能级观测到ν=3/4和5/4的偶数分母分数量子霍尔态。这两个态随密度升高（层间隧穿减弱、系统变为双组分）从复合费米子费米海演化为FQHS，且对电荷分布对称性极其敏感，不对称度仅约2%时即消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超高质量、72.5 nm宽GaAs量子阱中，首次在最低朗道能级观测到ν=3/4和5/4的偶数分母分数量子霍尔态。这两个态随密度升高（层间隧穿减弱、系统变为双组分）从复合费米子费米海演化为FQHS，且对电荷分布对称性极其敏感，不对称度仅约2%时即消失。；创新点：首次在最低朗道能级（N=0）发现ν=3/4和5/4的偶数分母分数量子霍尔态，并揭示其双组分本质及对层间隧穿和电荷对称性的极端敏感性，利用粒子-空穴对称性关联两个态，为宽量子阱中竞争能量尺度稳定新基态提供了关键实验证据。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：通过精确调控二维电子系统密度来调节层间隧穿强度，并控制量子阱中电荷分布对称性，测量分数量子霍尔态的行为。理论框架：采用Scarola-Jain双层复合费米子框架（推广的双组分Halperin Ψ331态）解释观测结果。

papers.title: Andreev exceptional points in Josephson junctions formed by minimal Kitaev chains
papers.abstract: We consider Josephson junctions formed by two minimal Kitaev chains and investigate how the interplay between non-Hermiticity and superconducting phase difference enables the realization of stable topological states that do not exist in the Hermitian realm. In particular, we focus on non-Hermiticity produced by coupling the minimal Kitaev chain Josephson junction to normal reservoirs, which renders the system open and characterized by a complex Andreev spectrum. Interestingly, we find that this complex spectrum hosts second order exceptional points, where a pair of eigenvalues and their respective eigenvectors coalesce, and are fully controlled by the superconducting phase difference. Depending on the spatial unequal distribution of non-Hermiticity, these Andreev exceptional points can appear at zero or finite energies connecting stable energy lines protected by non-Hermitian topology. Moreover, tuning the system parameters, such as onsite energies, non-Hermiticity, or electron cotunneling, the Andreev exceptional points give rise to Andreev exceptional lines enclosing protected two-dimensional zero real energy areas. We also discuss potential detection schemes of Andreev exceptional points by using local and nonlocal conductance signatures. Our results demonstrate the utility of non-Hermiticity from normal reservoirs as a useful resource for engineering non-Hermitian topological phases in minimal Kitaev chain Josephson junctions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：consider, investigate, demonstrate（理论分析与建模，未提及实验或计算模拟细节）。；研究对象：由两个最小Kitaev链构成的约瑟夫森结，以及其中非厄米性与超导相位差共同作用下的拓扑态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将最小Kitaev链约瑟夫森结耦合到正常储库引入非厄米性，可在复Andreev谱中实现由超导相位差完全控制的二阶Andreev奇异点，并由此产生受非厄米拓扑保护的能量线及二维零实能区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将最小Kitaev链约瑟夫森结耦合到正常储库引入非厄米性，可在复Andreev谱中实现由超导相位差完全控制的二阶Andreev奇异点，并由此产生受非厄米拓扑保护的能量线及二维零实能区域。；创新点：揭示了正常储库引入的非厄米性可作为工程化非厄米拓扑相的资源，在最小Kitaev链约瑟夫森结中实现厄米体系中不存在的稳定拓扑态，并首次系统描述了Andreev奇异点及其衍生奇异线的可控行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于最小Kitaev链约瑟夫森结的开放系统模型，通过耦合正常储库引入非厄米性，分析复Andreev谱的奇异点行为；通过调节系统参数（如格点能、非厄米强度、电子共隧穿）研究Andreev奇异点向Andreev奇异线的演化；提出利用局域和非局域电导信号探测Andreev奇异点的方案。

papers.title: Stress-Boundary-Memory Feedback Drives Vortical-Polar Transitions in Softly Confined Active Matter
papers.abstract: We computationally investigate how environmental sensitivity of active matter interacts with soft confinement to shape collective dynamics. In our model, the active constituents are represented as self-propelled particles (SPPs), implemented as nematic, disjoint ring polymers whose direction of motion can reverse without tumbling. Coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations reveal that collective dynamics arise from a three-way feedback between active stresses, boundary elasticity, and particle-level memory. With increasing driving force, FD, this feedback generates a sequence of collective dynamical regimes. At low FD, SPP motion is dominated by thermal fluctuations. At intermediate FD, coherent vortical motion emerges with intermittent, noise-driven reversals. With further increase in FD, reversals are suppressed, yielding sustained unidirectional vortical motion. At sufficiently high FD, the system transitions to a polar state characterized by strong nematic ordering of the SPPs, symmetry breaking of the enclosure shape, and persistent polar collective motion. In this regime, the SPPs accumulate at the leading edge of the enclosure, driving sustained ballistic propulsion. These results demonstrate how environmental sensitivity and soft confinement jointly regulate emergent collective states and identify boundary elasticity as a control parameter governing the balance between vortical and ballistic dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：computationally investigate、coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations。；研究对象：软约束活性物质中的涡旋-极性集体动力学转变，具体体系为自推进粒子（SPPs）构成的向列型环形聚合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性应力、边界弹性与粒子级记忆之间的三向反馈驱动了从热涨落主导到单向涡旋运动、再到极性集体运动的系列动力学相变，边界弹性可作为控制涡旋与弹道运动平衡的关键参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性应力、边界弹性与粒子级记忆之间的三向反馈驱动了从热涨落主导到单向涡旋运动、再到极性集体运动的系列动力学相变，边界弹性可作为控制涡旋与弹道运动平衡的关键参数。；创新点：揭示了活性物质的环境敏感性（粒子级记忆）与软约束（边界弹性）如何共同调控涌现集体态，并首次将边界弹性识别为控制涡旋与弹道动力学平衡的调控参数。
papers.method_zh: 粗粒化分子动力学模拟，模型采用向列型、不相交的环形聚合物作为自推进粒子，其运动方向可无翻滚地反转。

papers.title: Flexibility Controls Active-Filament Transport in Crowded Landscapes
papers.abstract: Active filaments, ranging from motor-driven biopolymers to elongated bacteria and worms, are paradigmatic examples of deformable active matter. How filament flexibility interacts with environmental heterogeneity to control their transport in crowded environments, however, remains poorly understood. Here, we perform large-scale Brownian dynamics simulations of tangentially driven active polymers moving through ordered and disordered obstacle arrays to map the long-time diffusion as a function of obstacle density and filament flexibility. We find that flexibility can either enhance or hinder transport depending on the structure of the medium. In disordered environments, transport is optimized at intermediate filament flexibility, whereas both highly flexible and semiflexible filaments diffuse more slowly. In contrast, dense ordered arrays enhance the mobility of semiflexible filaments by promoting directed motion along periodic channels. We identify three distinct transport regimes: (i) tortuosity-controlled diffusion of highly flexible filaments, characterized by trapping-and-hopping dynamics; (ii) confinement-assisted transport of moderately flexible filaments, which enhances diffusion in dense media; and (iii) persistence-controlled transport of semiflexible filaments, which facilitates diffusion in dense ordered media, but suppresses it in disordered media. Combining theory and simulations, we show that long-time diffusion is governed by confinement-induced changes in filament conformation and reorientation dynamics. Our work uncovers general transport principles for deformable active agents in heterogeneous environments and provides a predictive framework for active-filament navigation in complex porous landscapes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Brownian dynamics simulations、large-scale simulations）；研究对象：活性细丝（如马达驱动生物聚合物、细长细菌和蠕虫）在拥挤环境（有序/无序障碍物阵列）中的输运行为，重点研究细丝柔性与环境异质性的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 细丝柔性对输运的影响取决于介质结构：在无序环境中，中等柔性细丝扩散最优；在密集有序阵列中，半柔性细丝因沿周期性通道定向运动而增强迁移率。识别出三种输运机制：高柔性细丝的曲折度控制扩散、中等柔性细丝的受限辅助输运、半柔性细丝的持久性控制输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：细丝柔性对输运的影响取决于介质结构：在无序环境中，中等柔性细丝扩散最优；在密集有序阵列中，半柔性细丝因沿周期性通道定向运动而增强迁移率。识别出三种输运机制：高柔性细丝的曲折度控制扩散、中等柔性细丝的受限辅助输运、半柔性细丝的持久性控制输运。；创新点：揭示了柔性如何在不同结构环境中调控活性细丝输运的通用原理，并建立了基于构象和重定向动力学变化的预测框架。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对比或定量预测。
papers.method_zh: 大规模布朗动力学模拟，模拟切向驱动的活性聚合物在有序和无序障碍物阵列中的运动，结合理论分析研究长时间扩散系数与障碍物密度、细丝柔性的关系。

papers.title: Yielding versus random organization: convex absorbing transitions in soft matter
papers.abstract: We compare two different soft matter models, a generalized Random Organization Model (ROM) describing the stroboscopic dynamics of cyclically sheared suspensions, and an elastoplastic model describing the mesoscale dynamics of a yield-stress fluid under imposed stress. Both show absorbing phase transitions, sharing a peculiar mechanism: activity induces an internal noise which is transmitted over large distances by long-ranged mediated interactions, either hydrodynamic or elastic, which results in non-local creation of activity. They also both show convex transitions (i.e., the exponent $β>1$), in stark contrast with usual absorbing phase transitions, like (Conserved) Directed Percolation, which are concave ($β<1$). We further compare the dependence of the critical properties (activity mean value and fluctuations, avalanche statistics, low-wavenumber structure factor) on the decay exponent $α$ of long-range interactions in both models, finding a qualitatively similar scenario. A smooth crossover is observed as a function of $α$ between a concave transition regime for short-range interactions, with diverging fluctuations and compact avalanches, and a convex transition regime, with vanishing fluctuations and non-compact avalanches, for longer-range interactions. Although for a given range exponent $α$, the values of critical exponents for both models differ, a good agreement between the models is found by parametrically plotting the different critical exponents as a function of the exponent $β$ of the mean activity. In this parametric representation, the concave regime is consistent with the behavior of the Long-Range Conserved Directed Percolation class, while the convex regime can be accounted for by a mean-field-type scenario with anomalous diffusion close to an absorbing boundary, inspired by the Hébraud-Lequeux model for the yielding transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：模型比较、临界现象分析、标度关系）；研究对象：软物质中的屈服转变与随机组织过程，具体包括循环剪切悬浮液的随机组织模型（ROM）和应力作用下屈服流体的弹塑性模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两类模型均表现出凸型吸收相变（β>1），与通常的凹型吸收相变（如定向渗流，β<1）形成鲜明对比；通过将临界指数作为平均活性指数β的函数进行参数化绘图，两类模型在短程相互作用下符合长程守恒定向渗流类行为，在长程相互作用下则可用基于Hébraud-Lequeux模型的平均场框架描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两类模型均表现出凸型吸收相变（β>1），与通常的凹型吸收相变（如定向渗流，β<1）形成鲜明对比；通过将临界指数作为平均活性指数β的函数进行参数化绘图，两类模型在短程相互作用下符合长程守恒定向渗流类行为，在长程相互作用下则可用基于Hébraud-Lequeux模型的平均场框架描述。；创新点：揭示了软物质中一类新的凸型吸收相变机制，该机制源于长程（流体力学或弹性）相互作用导致的非局域活性产生，并建立了从短程到长程相互作用的平滑交叉图像。
papers.method_zh: 广义随机组织模型（ROM）与弹塑性模型的比较分析；通过改变长程相互作用的衰减指数α，研究临界性质（平均活性、涨落、雪崩统计、低波数结构因子）的依赖关系；采用参数化标度分析。

papers.title: Generalized Fourier's law in mesoscopic systems
papers.abstract: Fourier's law fails when the mean free path of the energy carriers becomes comparable to the length and time scales over which the temperature field varies. We derive a thermodynamically consistent generalization in which the conductivity is promoted to a nonlocal memory operator $\bmκ_{\mathrm{eff}}(\mathbf{k},ω)$, obtained by combining mesoscopic nonequilibrium thermodynamics with the Mori--Kubo--Zwanzig projection-operator formalism. The Onsager kernel decomposes exactly into a tensor sum over vibrational normal modes weighted by their Bose heat capacities and relaxation functions, and satisfies the second law by construction. Two consequences follow. First, because the modal weights carry the directional group velocity, the kernel is anisotropic, so a nominally isotropic crystal exhibits direction-dependent apparent conductivities $Λ_z\neqΛ_r$. Second, in a pump--probe experiment the modulation frequency does not introduce temporal memory but sets the probed wavevector through the thermal penetration depth, so the suppression of the apparent conductivity measured by time-domain thermoreflectance on Si, Ge and Si$_{1-x}$Ge$_x$ is a spatial-nonlocality effect set by a sub-micron carrier mean free path. Fitting the data of Wilson and Cahill yields nonlocality lengths of $0.25$--$0.4~μ$m consistent with the mean-free-path spectra of these crystals. The framework supplies a thermodynamic foundation for the two-channel ballistic/diffusive picture of nondiffusive heat transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive、thermodynamically consistent generalization、Mori--Kubo--Zwanzig projection-operator formalism。；研究对象：介观体系中非扩散热输运现象，具体涉及傅里叶定律失效时的热传导行为，并以硅（Si）、锗（Ge）及硅锗合金（Si₁₋ₓGeₓ）为例进行数据拟合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出一个热力学自洽的非局域记忆算子形式的广义傅里叶定律，该定律将热导率推广为波矢和频率的函数，并揭示名义上的各向同性晶体在介观尺度下会表现出方向依赖的表观热导率；同时，泵浦-探测实验中观测到的表观热导率抑制本质上是空间非局域性效应，而非时间记忆效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出一个热力学自洽的非局域记忆算子形式的广义傅里叶定律，该定律将热导率推广为波矢和频率的函数，并揭示名义上的各向同性晶体在介观尺度下会表现出方向依赖的表观热导率；同时，泵浦-探测实验中观测到的表观热导率抑制本质上是空间非局域性效应，而非时间记忆效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合介观非平衡热力学与Mori–Kubo–Zwanzig投影算子形式，推导出Onsager核的精确张量分解形式（按振动简正模式求和，权重为玻色热容和弛豫函数），并利用Wilson和Cahill的时域热反射（TDTR）实验数据进行拟合。

papers.title: Fine structure of the cyclotron resonance in heterobilayers of proximitized graphene and transition metal dichalcogenides
papers.abstract: A monolayer graphene and its Dirac electrons can be equipped with an enhanced spin-orbit coupling (SOC) when proximitized by other van der Waals (vdW) materials, such as transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs). In this work we analyze the cyclotron resonance (CR) absorption of such heterobilayers at quantizing magnetic fields in the presence of proximity-induced spin interactions, including the spin-pseudospin Rashba coupling. We evaluate the spin-textured wave functions of the Landau levels and calculate the absorption spectrum paying special attention to its spin proximity induced modifications. We reveal the formation of a fine double-peak structure of the main interband CR transitions, as well as the presence of additional spin-flip absorption, the combined cyclotron resonance (CCR), centered at different resonant frequencies. The selection rules for CCRs are identified and complemented by the perturbation theory analysis. We also discuss the polarization dependence of the absorption and the proximity-induced emerging magneto-optical responses. Our theory explains the effect of proximity-induced spin interactions for Dirac electrons cyclotron resonance and points out at its experimental verifications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“分析”“计算”“评估”“识别”等理论分析术语，未提及实验数据或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：石墨烯/过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）异质双层中的回旋共振（cyclotron resonance, CR）吸收，特别是近邻诱导自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）对朗道能级和光吸收谱的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在近邻诱导自旋相互作用（包括自旋-赝自旋Rashba耦合）存在下，主带间回旋共振跃迁会形成精细的双峰结构，并出现额外的自旋翻转吸收（即组合回旋共振，CCR），其共振频率不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在近邻诱导自旋相互作用（包括自旋-赝自旋Rashba耦合）存在下，主带间回旋共振跃迁会形成精细的双峰结构，并出现额外的自旋翻转吸收（即组合回旋共振，CCR），其共振频率不同。；创新点：揭示了近邻诱导自旋相互作用在狄拉克电子回旋共振中导致的精细双峰结构和自旋翻转吸收通道，并给出了组合回旋共振的选择定则，为实验验证提供了理论预测。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于自旋纹理化的朗道能级波函数计算吸收谱，结合微扰理论分析组合回旋共振的选择定则，并讨论极化依赖性和近邻诱导的磁光响应。

papers.title: Domain-wall drift in a ferrimagnet induced by a linearly oscillating in-plane magnetic field
papers.abstract: We investigate ferrimagnetic domain-wall dynamics under linearly oscillating in-plane magnetic fields. Starting from a ferrimagnetic Lagrangian that retains the field-dependent contribution to the kinetic energy, we derive collective-coordinate equations for the domain-wall position and azimuthal angle. This formulation makes explicit the field-induced inertial terms, including Coriolis-, Euler-, and centrifugal-like contributions, and clarifies how they couple translational and azimuthal dynamics. For an oscillating in-plane field supplemented by a weak static out-of-plane bias field, we show that periodic switching of the wall angle can be rectified into a finite average domain-wall velocity. At low drive frequencies, where the wall angle follows the oscillating field, the induced drift is proportional to the drive frequency rather than the field amplitude, while above a cutoff frequency the wall angle can no longer follow the drive and the average motion is suppressed. Micromagnetic simulations confirm the analytical predictions and demonstrate that the magnitude and direction of the drift can be tuned by the net spin density. These results identify linearly oscillating fields as a mechanism for frequency-controlled domain-wall motion in ferrimagnets and highlight the role of inertial spin dynamics near magnetic compensation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：推导了集体坐标方程，并进行了微磁学模拟（Micromagnetic simulations）。；研究对象：铁磁材料中亚铁磁畴壁在面内线性振荡磁场下的动力学行为，特别是畴壁的漂移运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在面内线性振荡磁场和弱静态面外偏置磁场共同作用下，畴壁角的周期性切换可被整流为有限平均畴壁速度；该漂移速度在低频下与驱动频率成正比，而非场振幅，且可通过净自旋密度调控其大小和方向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在面内线性振荡磁场和弱静态面外偏置磁场共同作用下，畴壁角的周期性切换可被整流为有限平均畴壁速度；该漂移速度在低频下与驱动频率成正比，而非场振幅，且可通过净自旋密度调控其大小和方向。；创新点：明确揭示了由振荡磁场诱导的惯性项（科里奥利、欧拉、离心力类贡献）如何耦合畴壁的平动与方位角动力学，并提出了利用线性振荡磁场实现频率控制的畴壁运动机制，强调了磁补偿点附近惯性自旋动力学的作用。
papers.method_zh: 从包含场依赖动能项的铁磁拉格朗日量出发，推导畴壁位置和方位角的集体坐标方程；结合微磁学模拟验证解析预测。

papers.title: Pareto-optimal control strategies in intrinsically nonequilibrium systems
papers.abstract: Thermodynamic control is typically formulated as the optimisation of a single objective, yet competing costs rarely admit a common optimum, so single-objective control captures only one corner of the achievable performance space. We develop a general framework for multi-objective thermodynamic control of intrinsically nonequilibrium systems that maps out the full Pareto front of optimal control strategies. We show that Pareto-optimal protocols generically consist of smooth branches connected by boundary jumps, and that the relative weights of the objectives combine with the physical parameters into a single intrinsic scale that alone governs the trade-off. Remarkably, this scale plays a double role: it parametrizes a single functional form that generates the entire front, and it defines control equivalence classes, in which systems with different parameters but the same scale share identical optimal strategies. We illustrate the framework for two paradigmatic systems that are experimentally accessible: transport of an active particle in a harmonic trap, and a cyclic quantum-dot engine. For both, we obtain the Pareto front and optimal strategies in closed form.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：develop a general framework、show、illustrate、obtain in closed form）；研究对象：内禀非平衡系统的多目标热力学控制策略，具体包括：谐振阱中活性粒子的输运、循环量子点引擎。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 帕累托最优控制协议通常由光滑分支和边界跳跃组成；目标函数的相对权重与物理参数结合成一个单一内禀尺度，该尺度唯一决定权衡关系，并定义控制等价类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：帕累托最优控制协议通常由光滑分支和边界跳跃组成；目标函数的相对权重与物理参数结合成一个单一内禀尺度，该尺度唯一决定权衡关系，并定义控制等价类。；创新点：首次系统性地为内禀非平衡系统建立多目标热力学控制的帕累托前沿框架，揭示单一内禀尺度同时参数化整个前沿并定义控制等价类。
papers.method_zh: 构建多目标热力学控制的理论框架，通过解析推导帕累托前沿和最优控制策略，并以两个可实验实现的系统（活性粒子输运、量子点引擎）为例进行封闭形式求解。

papers.title: Quantum turbulence in the many-body regime
papers.abstract: We discuss phenomenology associated with turbulent hydrodynamics in quantum fluids from a condensed-matter perspective. We begin with weakly-interacting superfluids, often modeled by a mean-field theory governed by the Gross-Pitaevskii equation. Considering the effect of quantum fluctuations beyond the mean-field approximation, we propose a study of many-body quantum effects in turbulent hydrodynamics, especially near zero temperature. We motivate examples of quantum many-body systems where such effects may be uncovered. These include bosons confined in a periodic potential in low spatial dimensions (one and two), and the associated quantum critical point of the superfluid-insulator transition, realized in present-day ultracold-atom and quantum computing platforms. We conclude by listing a set of (open) questions that may be answered using modern quantum many-body techniques. This article is part of the theme issue 'Frontiers of turbulence and statistical physics'.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“讨论 phenomenology”“提出研究”“动机举例”等理论探讨性表述，未提及实验或计算数据。；研究对象：量子流体中的湍流流体动力学，特别是弱相互作用超流体在接近零温时的多体量子效应，以及低维（一维和二维）周期性势阱中的玻色子体系及其超流-绝缘体量子临界点。

papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体物理结论，但提出在平均场近似（Gross-Pitaevskii方程）之外，量子涨落会在湍流流体动力学中引入多体量子效应，尤其在接近零温时可能显著。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。

papers.title: Universal Dynamical Response to Slow Driving in Chaotic Systems
papers.abstract: We propose a unified perspective on classical and quantum chaos based on the stability of a system's stationary states under slow driving. We probe this sensitivity via the system's susceptibility to the average protocol speed, which we call the ``speed-Fisher information," and relate it to irreversible entropy production in the system. We show that chaotic dynamics manifests as a divergence of the speed-Fisher information with the protocol time, and that this response is controlled by the perturbation's low-frequency spectral weight. This approach to chaos applies to both classical and quantum Hamiltonian systems, and naturally extends to non-Hamiltonian classical flows. We illustrate this framework with simple classical and quantum examples, along with a non-Hamiltonian flow that qualitatively exhibits analogous low-frequency spectral behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：提出统一视角、理论框架、经典与量子哈密顿系统、非哈密顿流。；研究对象：混沌系统（包括经典和量子哈密顿系统，以及非哈密顿经典流）在慢速驱动下的普适动力学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 混沌动力学表现为系统对驱动协议平均速度的敏感性（即“速度-费舍尔信息”）随协议时间发散，且该响应由扰动的低频谱权重控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：混沌动力学表现为系统对驱动协议平均速度的敏感性（即“速度-费舍尔信息”）随协议时间发散，且该响应由扰动的低频谱权重控制。；创新点：提出了一个统一视角，将经典混沌和量子混沌基于系统稳态在慢速驱动下的稳定性联系起来，并建立了混沌动力学与低频谱权重之间的直接联系。该框架自然延伸至非哈密顿经典流。

papers.title: Nonrelativistic Spin-Orbit-Coupling Effects in Odd-Parity Coplanar Magnets
papers.abstract: Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) is a relativistic effect that underpins a broad spectrum of phenomena in condensed matter physics, from topological phases of matter to spintronic functionality. Its relativistic origin, however, restricts strong SOC to heavy-element materials and locks spin-momentum texture into a fixed, material-specific pattern. Here we show that odd-parity coplanar magnets offer a nonrelativistic pathway to highly tunable SOC effects. We construct a bilayer coplanar magnet via symmetry-guided stacking of two monolayer odd-parity altermagnets and demonstrate that Rashba, Weyl, and Dresselhaus spin textures can all be realized, and that the spin texture can be switched between these forms simply by tuning the layer Neel vector. Through the spin Edelstein effect and the realization of fully gapped chiral topological superconducting phases, we demonstrate that this nonrelativistic SOC achieves physical equivalence to its relativistic counterpart. Our findings identify a new class of odd-parity coplanar magnets as a versatile platform for engineering SOC effects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we show”“we construct”“we demonstrate”等理论推导和模型构建的表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：奇宇称共面磁体（odd-parity coplanar magnets）中的非相对论性自旋-轨道耦合效应，具体为通过堆叠两层单层奇宇称交变磁体构建的双层共面磁体体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 奇宇称共面磁体能够实现高度可调的非相对论性自旋-轨道耦合效应，通过调节层内奈尔矢量即可在Rashba、Weyl和Dresselhaus自旋织构之间切换，并在自旋Edelstein效应和手性拓扑超导相中达到与相对论性自旋-轨道耦合物理等效的效果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：奇宇称共面磁体能够实现高度可调的非相对论性自旋-轨道耦合效应，通过调节层内奈尔矢量即可在Rashba、Weyl和Dresselhaus自旋织构之间切换，并在自旋Edelstein效应和手性拓扑超导相中达到与相对论性自旋-轨道耦合物理等效的效果。；创新点：首次提出在非相对论性体系中（奇宇称共面磁体）实现高度可调的自旋-轨道耦合效应，突破了传统相对论性自旋-轨道耦合对重元素材料和固定自旋-动量织构的限制。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性指导的模型构建（symmetry-guided stacking），通过堆叠两个单层奇宇称交变磁体形成双层共面磁体，并理论分析其自旋织构、自旋Edelstein效应及拓扑超导相。

papers.title: Fermi surface change and $d$-wave superconductivity in the square lattice Kondo-Heisenberg model
papers.abstract: We study the two-dimensional Kondo-Heisenberg model on a square lattice, with the conduction electrons away from half-filling, using neural network quantum states. Mapping the ground-state phase diagram as a function of the Kondo and Heisenberg couplings, we identify (i) at weak Kondo coupling, antiferromagnetic Néel order with a Fermi surface whose enclosed area counts only the conduction electrons and is insensitive to the Néel order, and (ii) at strong coupling, a heavy Fermi liquid with a Fermi surface whose enclosed area counts both the conduction electrons and the spins. In the crossover between these regimes, we find $d_{x^2-y^2}$ superconductivity, evidenced by off-diagonal long-range order in the pair-pair correlations and a pairing-amplitude dome that coexists with the underlying magnetic phase. Our results establish Fermi volume change and unconventional superconductivity as intrinsic features of the two-dimensional Kondo-Heisenberg model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用神经网络量子态（neural network quantum states）进行数值计算，研究模型基态相图。；研究对象：二维正方晶格上的Kondo-Heisenberg模型，其中传导电子偏离半填充。具体物理现象包括：费米面变化、d波超导、反铁磁Néel序、重费米液体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱Kondo耦合下体系呈现反铁磁Néel序，费米面仅包含传导电子；在强Kondo耦合下体系变为重费米液体，费米面同时包含传导电子和自旋。在这两个区域之间的交叉区域，发现了d_{x^2-y^2}超导，表现为配对-配对关联中的非对角长程序以及配对振幅穹顶与磁相共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱Kondo耦合下体系呈现反铁磁Néel序，费米面仅包含传导电子；在强Kondo耦合下体系变为重费米液体，费米面同时包含传导电子和自旋。在这两个区域之间的交叉区域，发现了d_{x^2-y^2}超导，表现为配对-配对关联中的非对角长程序以及配对振幅穹顶与磁相共存。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。

papers.title: Visualizing Symmetry Broken Chern Insulators and their Quantum Melting
papers.abstract: In the presence of a magnetic field, electronic states of moiré quantum materials develop a Hofstadter spectrum that provides a unique setting for studying the interplay between band topology and strong electron-electron interaction. Using scanning tunneling microscopy, we study Hofstadter's states in bilayer graphene aligned with hexagonal BN and directly visualize the formation of interaction-driven symmetry breaking Chern insulators. Our measurements reveal the formation of phases that double, triple or quadruple the moiré unit cell at fractional filling of the Hofstadter bands, as well as states with complex intra-unit-cell wave functions. We visualize two distinct quantum phenomena in different Chern states, including quantum melting driven by the appearance and proliferation of topological defects, and a quantum transition co-occurring with phase competition and separation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：scanning tunneling microscopy（扫描隧道显微镜）、visualize（直接成像）、measurements（测量）。；研究对象：在磁场下，六方氮化硼（hBN）对齐的双层石墨烯中的Hofstadter态，以及由此形成的相互作用驱动的对称性破缺陈绝缘体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验直接观测到在Hofstadter能带分数填充时，莫尔原胞发生倍增（二倍、三倍或四倍）的对称性破缺陈绝缘体相，并可视化了两类量子现象：由拓扑缺陷出现和增殖驱动的量子熔化，以及与相竞争和相分离共存的量子转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验直接观测到在Hofstadter能带分数填充时，莫尔原胞发生倍增（二倍、三倍或四倍）的对称性破缺陈绝缘体相，并可视化了两类量子现象：由拓扑缺陷出现和增殖驱动的量子熔化，以及与相竞争和相分离共存的量子转变。；创新点：首次通过实空间成像直接可视化Hofstadter能带中相互作用驱动的对称性破缺陈绝缘体相，并揭示了不同陈数态中量子熔化与拓扑缺陷动力学、以及相竞争与相分离等微观过程。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜（STM），用于直接成像Hofstadter态、莫尔原胞的对称性破缺以及原胞内的复杂波函数。

papers.title: Notes on remanent magnetization measurements in superconductors and hard ferromagnets
papers.abstract: Data on zero applied field measurements of remanent magnetization and magnetic relaxation in a BCS superconductor LuNi2B2C and several hard ferromagnets are presented and compared. Apparent similarities and differences, in particular in Thermoremanent Magnetization (TRM) - like, Isothermal Remanent Magnetization (IRM) - like, and remanent magnetization measurements with zigzag temperature sweep measurements are outlined. It is discussed how these results could be relevant for the magnetization measurements in diamond anvil cells.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：measurements（测量）、data presented（数据呈现）、compared（比较）。；研究对象：BCS超导体LuNi2B2C与几种硬铁磁体中的剩余磁化强度（remanent magnetization）和磁弛豫（magnetic relaxation）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零外加磁场下，BCS超导体与硬铁磁体的剩余磁化强度测量（包括热剩余磁化、等温剩余磁化及锯齿温度扫描测量）表现出表观相似性与差异性，这些结果可能对金刚石对顶砧中的磁化测量具有参考意义。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零外加磁场下，BCS超导体与硬铁磁体的剩余磁化强度测量（包括热剩余磁化、等温剩余磁化及锯齿温度扫描测量）表现出表观相似性与差异性，这些结果可能对金刚石对顶砧中的磁化测量具有参考意义。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 零场剩余磁化强度测量、磁弛豫测量、热剩余磁化（TRM）类测量、等温剩余磁化（IRM）类测量、锯齿温度扫描（zigzag temperature sweep）测量。

papers.title: Interpretable Material Spatial Intelligence for Discovery of Governing Microstructural Features
papers.abstract: Many material systems exhibit complex spatial and temporal interactions across multiple length scales and modalities that govern macroscopic behavior. Although Machine Learning (ML) is widely used in materials science to predict this behavior, most approaches still rely on handcrafted descriptors or aggregated representations that overlook spatial organization, limiting insight into governing mechanisms. We introduce Materials Spatial Intelligence (MSI), a framework inspired by spatial intelligence that learns directly from multimodal spatial observations of material systems. MSI encodes high-resolution microstructural and deformation data into shared latent representations that preserve spatial relationships while supporting property prediction, interpretation, and optimization. By combining multimodal representation learning, MSI identifies the key features governing mechanical behavior and property trade-offs in structural alloys. Beyond prediction, MSI enables feature-driven microstructure optimization and mechanism discovery. More broadly, MSI establishes a foundation for applying spatial intelligence to materials science, leveraging interpretable ML systems to accelerate scientific discovery and materiel design
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Machine Learning (ML)、multimodal representation learning、interpretable ML systems。；研究对象：结构合金中的微观组织与宏观力学行为之间的关系，具体关注多尺度、多模态空间观测数据（高分辨率微观结构与变形数据）中隐含的调控机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出Materials Spatial Intelligence (MSI)框架，能够直接从多模态空间观测中学习共享潜在表征，识别控制力学行为与性能权衡的关键微观组织特征，并实现特征驱动的微观结构优化与机制发现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出Materials Spatial Intelligence (MSI)框架，能够直接从多模态空间观测中学习共享潜在表征，识别控制力学行为与性能权衡的关键微观组织特征，并实现特征驱动的微观结构优化与机制发现。；创新点：相较于依赖手工描述符或聚合表征的传统机器学习方法，MSI直接学习空间组织信息，从而保留空间关系并支持对调控机制的深入理解，同时实现可解释的微观结构优化与机制发现。
papers.method_zh: 基于空间智能启发的多模态表征学习框架（MSI），将高分辨率微观结构与变形数据编码为保留空间关系的共享潜在表征，结合机器学习进行属性预测、解释与优化。

papers.title: Computational references are not experiments: pre-registered validation of machine-learned sodium-cathode voltages
papers.abstract: Machine-learning screens for battery materials are trained and judged almost entirely against computed reference voltages, and those references carry their own systematic errors. We report a case in which this matters quantitatively: our own screening stack (a graph-network voltage screen, a prior-art triage layer, and a local PBE+U bench) fails pre-registered validation against experiment-anchored literature values. Verdict thresholds, failure modes, and the primary metric were committed before analysis. On an operator-audited set of known Na-ion cathodes (n = 6 after one documented exclusion; verdict unchanged at n = 7), the raw held-out mean absolute error was 0.67 V, the pre-registered conservative metric, the upper 95% confidence bound of the cross-validated bias-corrected error, was 1.09 V, and the residual was strongly voltage-dependent (r = -0.94), so no additive calibration is valid. On the two compounds where prediction, database reference, and experiment could all be compared, the Materials Project PBE+U reference sat about 0.54 V below measurement: the reference, not the model, dominated the error. A prior-art screen found at least 70% of the targeted Na substitution space already published. We retire the screen, bound what "verified" means for our DFT ledger, and pre-register a calibration audit of it against four benchmark Li couples.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（判断依据：machine-learning screens, computed reference voltages, DFT ledger, pre-registered validation）；研究对象：钠离子电池正极材料（Na-ion cathodes）的电压预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于机器学习的钠离子电池正极电压筛选流程，在预先注册的验证中未能通过实验锚定文献值的检验。其误差主要来源于作为参考标准的DFT计算（PBE+U）的系统性偏差，而非机器学习模型本身。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于机器学习的钠离子电池正极电压筛选流程，在预先注册的验证中未能通过实验锚定文献值的检验。其误差主要来源于作为参考标准的DFT计算（PBE+U）的系统性偏差，而非机器学习模型本身。；创新点：该工作通过预先注册的验证流程，定量揭示了计算参考数据（DFT）的系统误差在机器学习筛选中的主导作用，并指出仅以计算参考值作为训练和评判标准会掩盖这一根本性问题。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习筛选流程（图网络电压筛选 + 先验分类层 + 局域PBE+U基准测试）；预先注册验证（pre-registered validation）；误差分析（留出法平均绝对误差、交叉验证偏差校正误差的95%置信上限、电压依赖性残差分析）。

papers.title: Field-like Perturbation Enabled Six-state Readout in Triaxial $α$-$\mathrm{Fe}_{2}\mathrm{O}_{3}$|Pt Bi-layers
papers.abstract: Understanding current-induced spin-orbit torques provides a route for all-electrical control of antiferromagnetic (AFM) order. Here, we demonstrate the reading of six-state memory stabilized by easy-plane triaxial anisotropy in canted antiferromagnetic $α$-$\mathrm{Fe}_{2}\mathrm{O}_{3}$|Pt bilayers. The conventional spin Hall magnetoresistance (SMR) readout cannot distinguish states separated by $180^\circ$, limiting detection to only three states in $α$-$\mathrm{Fe}_{2}\mathrm{O}_{3}$. We show that a static field-like perturbation via external field lifts the degeneracy of opposite states in $α$-$\mathrm{Fe}_{2}\mathrm{O}_{3}$, enabling unambiguous resolution of all six states in the first-harmonic SMR signal. Our analytical and numerical modeling elucidate the role of spontaneous canting in lifting such degeneracy in $α$-$\mathrm{Fe}_{2}\mathrm{O}_{3}$. We demonstrate that dual-modulation SMR measurements (simultaneous current and field excitations) are effective in mitigating thermal drifts in the signals and are essential for reliable readout. Furthermore, our computations of the second-harmonic SMR reveal the interplay of competing interactions governing the decisive lifting of the degeneracy of opposite states. Finally, we propose a two-step current-only protocol for six-state readout in canted AFM $α$-$\mathrm{Fe}_{2}\mathrm{O}_{3}$|Pt bilayers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中同时包含实验演示（“demonstrate the reading of six-state memory”）和理论建模（“analytical and numerical modeling”）。；研究对象：canted 反铁磁 α-Fe₂O₃|Pt 双层异质结中的六态存储读取，具体涉及面内三轴各向异性、自旋轨道矩、自旋霍尔磁电阻（SMR）等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过施加静态类场扰动（外磁场）可解除 α-Fe₂O₃ 中相反态（180° 间隔）的简并，从而在首次谐波 SMR 信号中实现全部六个态的明确分辨；同时提出一种仅依赖电流的两步读取协议。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过施加静态类场扰动（外磁场）可解除 α-Fe₂O₃ 中相反态（180° 间隔）的简并，从而在首次谐波 SMR 信号中实现全部六个态的明确分辨；同时提出一种仅依赖电流的两步读取协议。；创新点：首次在易面三轴各向异性的 canted 反铁磁 α-Fe₂O₃|Pt 双层中实现六态读取，克服了传统 SMR 无法区分 180° 相反态的限制；提出双调制 SMR 方法有效消除热漂移，并设计了全电流操作的两步读取协议。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用首次谐波和二次谐波 SMR 测量，并引入双调制 SMR 测量（同时施加电流和磁场激励）以抑制热漂移；理论上通过解析和数值建模分析自发倾斜磁矩在解除简并中的作用，并计算二次谐波 SMR 揭示竞争相互作用的机制。

papers.title: Structural symmetry effects on the competition of density waves and superconductivity in bilayer nickelates
papers.abstract: We investigate the interplay between spin-density-wave (SDW) order and superconductivity in the bilayer nickelate La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ using the functional renormalization group~(fRG) applied to multiorbital weak-coupling models of both the ambient- and high-pressure crystal structures. As Hund's coupling increases, the leading instability evolves from superconductivity to an SDW state with ordering vector $\mathbf{Q}_1 \approx (π/2,π/2)$ (equivalently $\mathbf{Q}_Y \approx (0,π)$ in the orthorhombic $Amam$ unit cell), in agreement with experimental observations. Surprisingly, the ambient- and high-pressure structures exhibit nearly identical non-interacting susceptibilities and leading fRG instabilities, indicating that the emergence of superconductivity under pressure cannot be explained solely by changes in the low-energy electronic structure. Instead, our results identify the suppression of orthorhombicity as a key ingredient for superconductivity. As the system approaches the tetragonal limit, symmetry-related SDW fluctuations become nearly degenerate, frustrating long-range magnetic order while enhancing pairing interactions. These findings highlight lattice symmetry as a central tuning parameter of the competing ordered states in bilayer nickelates and suggest that reducing orthorhombicity through uniaxial strain could stabilize bulk superconductivity already at ambient pressure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：使用了功能重整化群（fRG）方法对多轨道弱耦合模型进行分析。；研究对象：双层镍氧化物La₃Ni₂O₇中自旋密度波（SDW）序与超导电性之间的竞争关系，特别关注环境压力与高压晶体结构下的对称性效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着Hund耦合增强，体系的主导不稳定性从超导电性转变为波矢Q₁≈(π/2,π/2)的SDW态；环境压力与高压结构在非相互作用磁化率和fRG不稳定性上几乎相同，表明压力下超导电性的出现不能仅由低能电子结构变化解释，而需要抑制正交畸变（orthorhombicity）这一关键因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着Hund耦合增强，体系的主导不稳定性从超导电性转变为波矢Q₁≈(π/2,π/2)的SDW态；环境压力与高压结构在非相互作用磁化率和fRG不稳定性上几乎相同，表明压力下超导电性的出现不能仅由低能电子结构变化解释，而需要抑制正交畸变（orthorhombicity）这一关键因素。；创新点：揭示了晶格对称性（特别是正交畸变的抑制）是调控双层镍氧化物中竞争有序态的核心参数，并指出通过单轴应变降低正交性可能在常压下稳定体超导电性。
papers.method_zh: 功能重整化群（fRG）方法，应用于环境压力与高压晶体结构的多轨道弱耦合模型。

papers.title: Polyatomic Thermal Radiative Dissociation in Microcavities
papers.abstract: Blackbody infrared radiative dissociation (BIRD) activates molecules through successive absorption of ambient thermal photons until the internal energy reaches a dissociation threshold. Because these radiative transition rates depend on the electromagnetic density of states (DOS), structured infrared environments provide a route to control thermal unimolecular dissociation. Here we develop a state-resolved master-equation framework for polyatomic BIRD in a planar Au/MgO multilayer cavity, where the reactive cluster $\mathrm{(H_2O)_2Cl^-}$ is studied. The cavity modifies the kinetics through the DOS sampled by anharmonic fundamental, overtone, and combination transitions. We show that MgO surface phonon polaritons produce strong near-field enhancements in the central vacuum reaction region of a microcavity. We find that short cavities with thick polar crystal layers yield the largest BIRD enhancements due to enhanced evanescent surface phonon polariton contributions. We further include collisions with a methane bath gas and show that cavity DOS engineering shifts the crossover between BIRD and collisional activation. These results establish Reststrahlen-band DOS engineering as a practical strategy for controlling polyatomic BIRD in infrared microcavities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a state-resolved master-equation framework”（发展态分辨主方程框架），以及“show that”、“find that”等理论推导和计算分析表述，未提及实验数据或实验手段。；研究对象：微腔中多原子分子的黑体红外辐射解离（BIRD）过程，具体研究体系为反应性团簇 (H₂O)₂Cl⁻，以及平面Au/MgO多层微腔结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 微腔通过改变电磁态密度（DOS），特别是利用MgO表面声子极化激元在近场产生的增强效应，可以显著调控多原子分子的热辐射解离动力学；短腔与厚极性晶体层结合可最大化BIRD增强，且腔DOS工程能改变BIRD与碰撞活化之间的竞争关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：微腔通过改变电磁态密度（DOS），特别是利用MgO表面声子极化激元在近场产生的增强效应，可以显著调控多原子分子的热辐射解离动力学；短腔与厚极性晶体层结合可最大化BIRD增强，且腔DOS工程能改变BIRD与碰撞活化之间的竞争关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断：首次将Reststrahlen波段（剩余射线带）的电磁态密度工程应用于控制微腔中多原子分子的黑体红外辐射解离（BIRD），并系统分析了表面声子极化激元在近场增强中的作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用态分辨主方程框架（state-resolved master-equation framework），考虑非简谐基频、泛频和组合跃迁所采样的电磁态密度（DOS），并引入甲烷缓冲气体的碰撞效应。

papers.title: Quantum nuclear and band-dispersion effects recover near-UV absorption in short-hydrogen-bonded organic crystals
papers.abstract: Near-UV optical absorption is increasingly reported in hydrogen-bonded organic and biomolecular materials lacking aromatic or extended pi-conjugated chromophores, yet its microscopic origin remains unresolved and electronic-structure calculations often overestimate experimental absorption onsets. Here, we combine machine-learned interatomic potentials for large-scale classical and quantum nuclear sampling with periodic excited-state calculations to address this discrepancy in L-pyroglutamine ammonium, an experimentally established glutamine-derived crystal containing a well-resolved short hydrogen bond and exhibiting non-aromatic near-UV optical response. Using controlled in silico ion substitutions that vary the surrounding hydrogen-bond environment while preserving this scaffold, we compute optical spectra from configurations sampled along classical and quantum nuclear trajectories using hybrid-functional time-dependent density functional theory. We show that nuclear quantum effects stabilise proton-sharing configurations that are strongly suppressed classically, redshifting the lowest bright excitations by 0.5-0.8 eV and raising the fraction of configurations with bright excitations below 6 eV from approximately 3% to approximately 30%. Explicit Brillouin-zone sampling provides a further, mechanistically distinct redshift of 0.5-1.1 eV, reflecting modest but significant indirect electronic character. Only when both effects are incorporated does the calculated onset recover the experimental 3.8-4.5 eV range. These results establish quantum proton fluctuations and reciprocal-space convergence as cooperative but physically distinct ingredients required for predictive optical spectroscopy of strongly hydrogen-bonded molecular materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词包括“machine-learned interatomic potentials”、“periodic excited-state calculations”、“hybrid-functional time-dependent density functional theory”。；研究对象：L-吡咯谷氨酰胺铵（L-pyroglutamine ammonium）晶体，这是一种含有明确短氢键、无芳香环或扩展π共轭发色团、但表现出近紫外光学响应的有机晶体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 核量子效应（质子涨落）和能带色散效应（布里渊区采样）共同作用，使计算的光学吸收边从约3%的构型具有低于6 eV的亮激发，提升至约30%，并分别产生0.5-0.8 eV和0.5-1.1 eV的红移，最终使理论吸收边与实验观测的3.8-4.5 eV范围一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：核量子效应（质子涨落）和能带色散效应（布里渊区采样）共同作用，使计算的光学吸收边从约3%的构型具有低于6 eV的亮激发，提升至约30%，并分别产生0.5-0.8 eV和0.5-1.1 eV的红移，最终使理论吸收边与实验观测的3.8-4.5 eV范围一致。；创新点：首次将核量子效应与能带色散效应作为两个独立但协同的物理因素，共同解释强氢键有机晶体中近紫外吸收的起源，解决了以往电子结构计算高估吸收边的长期矛盾。
papers.method_zh: 采用机器学习原子间势进行大规模经典和量子核采样，结合杂化泛函含时密度泛函理论（hybrid-functional TDDFT）计算光学吸收谱；通过受控的计算机离子替换改变氢键环境；并显式进行布里渊区采样以考虑间接电子跃迁效应。

papers.title: Symmetric mass generation of interacting chiral fermions on a one-dimensional lattice without fermion doubling
papers.abstract: Symmetric mass generation is the interaction-induced opening of a fermion gap without spontaneous symmetry breaking. The anomaly-free 3-4-5-0 model of Wang and Wen provides a minimal one-dimensional setting for this phenomenon, but a direct lattice realization faces two obstacles: fermion doubling for local chiral discretizations and perturbative irrelevance of the six-fermion gapping interaction. We address both obstacles. First, we formulate the model on a strictly one-dimensional tangent-fermion lattice, where a nonlocal hopping produces a single chiral branch without a mirror partner while retaining an efficient tensor-network representation. Second, we add a Hubbard-type density-density interaction (Luttinger parameter $K$) that reduces the scaling dimension of the 3-4-5-0 interaction from $5$ to $5K$, making it relevant for $K<2/5$. Density-matrix renormalization group calculations show the opening of an excitation gap in this regime without the appearance of a degenerate ground state, the hallmark of symmetric mass generation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Density-matrix renormalization group calculations”（密度矩阵重正化群计算），属于数值计算方法，并结合了理论分析（如标度维数、Luttinger参数）。；研究对象：一维晶格上相互作用的无反常手征费米子模型（3-4-5-0模型），具体研究对称质量生成现象——即通过相互作用打开费米子能隙而不伴随自发对称性破缺。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在一维切向费米子晶格上引入Hubbard型密度-密度相互作用，将六费米子耦合相互作用的标度维数从5降低至5K（K为Luttinger参数），当K<2/5时该相互作用成为相关项，从而在无费米子加倍的情况下实现对称质量生成，表现为激发能隙打开且无简并基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在一维切向费米子晶格上引入Hubbard型密度-密度相互作用，将六费米子耦合相互作用的标度维数从5降低至5K（K为Luttinger参数），当K<2/5时该相互作用成为相关项，从而在无费米子加倍的情况下实现对称质量生成，表现为激发能隙打开且无简并基态。；创新点：首次在一维晶格上同时解决了实现对称质量生成的两个障碍：通过切向费米子构造避免了费米子加倍问题，并通过引入Hubbard型相互作用使原本微扰无关的六费米子项变为相关项，从而在严格一维体系中实现了无费米子加倍的对称质量生成。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值计算：采用非局域跳迁的切向费米子晶格构造单手征分支；通过Luttinger液体理论分析相互作用对六费米子项标度维数的调控；使用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）计算验证能隙打开及基态非简并性。

papers.title: Bode-Fano Limits to Broadband Absorption by Small Particles
papers.abstract: Nanostructures can be designed to absorb light efficiently at resonance despite their subwavelength footprint, but causality and passivity fundamentally limit the bandwidth over which strong absorption can be maintained. Here we derive fundamental absorption-bandwidth limits for passive, causal, linear, and temporally dispersive subwavelength objects by rigorously casting electromagnetic scattering as an equivalent impedance-matching problem. This mapping yields ultimate Bode-Fano-type constraints for optical absorption and provides rational synthesis guidelines for the material dispersion of passive nanoparticles that can approach the bounds. Our results clarify the ultimate limits for broadband light harvesting and dissipation, with implications for solar-energy conversion, photothermal hyperthermia, thermal management, and related nanophotonic technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：derive fundamental limits、rigorously casting、provides rational synthesis guidelines。；研究对象：亚波长纳米颗粒的宽带光吸收问题，具体涉及被动、因果、线性、时间色散的小尺寸物体在光学吸收中的带宽极限。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将电磁散射严格映射为等效阻抗匹配问题，推导出亚波长物体宽带吸收的Bode-Fano型基本极限，并给出了可接近该极限的被动纳米颗粒材料色散理性合成指南。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将电磁散射严格映射为等效阻抗匹配问题，推导出亚波长物体宽带吸收的Bode-Fano型基本极限，并给出了可接近该极限的被动纳米颗粒材料色散理性合成指南。；创新点：首次将Bode-Fano极限理论系统应用于亚波长颗粒的宽带光吸收问题，建立了电磁散射与阻抗匹配之间的严格映射，并提供了接近理论极限的材料色散设计准则。
papers.method_zh: 采用因果性与无源性约束下的电磁散射理论，将光学吸收问题转化为等效阻抗匹配问题，应用Bode-Fano极限分析方法推导吸收带宽的物理上限。

papers.title: Quantum-enabled active matter at the atomic scale
papers.abstract: Active matter comprises particles that extract energy from their local environment and convert it into motion. Although active particles have been miniaturized down to the nanoscale, realizing activity at the fundamentally smaller scale of individual atoms remains an open challenge, where quantum effects become increasingly relevant. Here, we experimentally demonstrate that individual Cs-133 atoms confined in an optical dipole trap extract energy from an ultracold bath of Rb-87 atoms via quantum-mechanical spin interactions and convert it into active motion. We quantitatively reproduce the resulting dynamics using a parameter-free active Langevin model derived from kinetic theory and support it with event-driven Monte Carlo collision simulations. The microscopic origin of activity is identified as quantum spin exchange, which transfers discrete internal spin energy into kinetic motion. Our work establishes a quantum-enabled route to active matter at the fundamental size limit of single atoms and opens perspectives for exploring the interplay of activity, quantum physics, and mesoscopic non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experiment demonstrate, 实验展示）；研究对象：原子尺度的活性物质，具体为囚禁在光偶极阱中的单个铯-133原子与超冷铷-87原子浴构成的系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过量子力学自旋相互作用，单个原子可以从超冷原子浴中提取能量并转化为活性运动，首次在单个原子的极限尺度上实现了活性物质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过量子力学自旋相互作用，单个原子可以从超冷原子浴中提取能量并转化为活性运动，首次在单个原子的极限尺度上实现了活性物质。；创新点：将活性物质的研究尺度从纳米级推进到单个原子的根本极限，并揭示了其微观起源是量子自旋交换过程，建立了实现活性物质的量子路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用光偶极阱囚禁单个铯原子，并使其与超冷铷原子浴接触；理论上，基于动理学理论推导出无参数活性朗之万模型，并辅以事件驱动的蒙特卡洛碰撞模拟来定量复现动力学过程。

papers.title: Emergent Self-Organisation of Intelligent Active Particles
papers.abstract: Intelligent active particles are characterized by self-propulsion, directional sensing of their environment, information processing, decision making and goal-oriented self-steering. This implies, in particular, the prevalence of non-reciprocal interactions, and the importance of information propagation through agent groups. Examples include biological systems (cells, insects, birds, fish, pedestrians) as well as engineered systems (nano- and microbots). As many agents move in an aqueous medium, hydrodynamic interactions strongly affect the dynamics.
