The emergent dynamics includes the formation of swarms and flocks, predator-prey behavior, and the navigation in complex environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：emergent dynamics、self-organisation、non-reciprocal interactions、information propagation）；研究对象：智能活性粒子（intelligent active particles）群体，包括生物系统（细胞、昆虫、鸟类、鱼类、行人）和工程系统（纳米/微型机器人）中的涌现自组织行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 智能活性粒子通过非互易相互作用和信息传播，可涌现出群体聚集（swarms/flocks）、捕食者-猎物行为以及在复杂环境中的导航等集体动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：智能活性粒子通过非互易相互作用和信息传播，可涌现出群体聚集（swarms/flocks）、捕食者-猎物行为以及在复杂环境中的导航等集体动力学。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架或数值方法，但提及了“hydrodynamic interactions”（水动力学相互作用）作为关键影响机制，暗示可能涉及连续介质理论或粒子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Temperature distribution measurement on three-phase contact line in liquid nitrogen using two-color temperature-sensitive paint
papers.abstract: Cryogenic phase-change phenomena play an important role in a wide range of engineering applications, including cryogenic cooling systems, superconducting technologies, and space propulsion systems. In particular, the three-phase contact line is recognized as a key region governing evaporation and heat transfer. However, direct measurements of temperature distributions near cryogenic three-phase contact lines remain limited because conventional infrared thermography becomes increasingly difficult at extremely low temperatures. In this study, a two-color temperature-sensitive paint (2C-TSP) technique was applied to visualize the temperature field around a liquid-nitrogen three-phase contact line. A temperature-sensitive dye and a temperature-insensitive reference dye were incorporated into a single coating, enabling robust temperature measurements based on luminescence intensity ratios by compensating for changes in optical intensity caused by refraction and reflection at the liquid-gas interface. Temperature distributions were measured under three heating conditions with heat fluxes of 110, 430, and 900 W/m2. The measured temperature fields revealed a localized temperature minimum at the observed three-phase contact line, suggesting localized cooling associated with phase change. Quantitative analysis showed that the average temperature in the liquid region remained nearly constant, whereas the temperature in the gas region increased with increasing heat flux. These observations reveal a non-uniform thermal structure around the cryogenic three-phase contact line. The present results demonstrate that 2C-TSP is a promising technique for direct visualization of temperature fields around cryogenic three-phase contact lines and provides new insights into phase-change phenomena in liquid nitrogen.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“applied to visualize”“measured”“quantitative analysis”表明该研究通过实验手段进行温度场测量。；研究对象：液氮三相接触线附近的温度分布，具体涉及低温相变现象中的热传递与蒸发过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在液氮三相接触线处观测到局部温度最低点，表明该区域存在与相变相关的局部冷却效应；气体区域温度随热流密度增加而升高，而液体区域平均温度几乎不变，揭示了接触线周围非均匀的热结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在液氮三相接触线处观测到局部温度最低点，表明该区域存在与相变相关的局部冷却效应；气体区域温度随热流密度增加而升高，而液体区域平均温度几乎不变，揭示了接触线周围非均匀的热结构。；创新点：首次将双色温敏漆技术应用于低温（液氮）三相接触线的温度场直接可视化测量，克服了传统红外热成像在极低温下难以测量的限制，为研究低温相变现象提供了新的实验手段。
papers.method_zh: 采用双色温敏漆（2C-TSP）技术，通过将温度敏感染料与温度不敏感参考染料混合涂覆，利用发光强度比率补偿液-气界面折射和反射引起的光强变化，实现低温下三相接触线温度场的直接可视化测量。实验在三种热流密度（110、430、900 W/m²）下进行。

papers.title: Uniaxial poroelastic tendon model with crimped fibre recruitment
papers.abstract: Fibre recruitment plays an important role in tendon and other biological soft tissue mechanics. Due to their large water content, a popular modelling approach for tendons is poroelasticity. Within this framework some tendon studies have included fibres, though none have included crimped fibre recruitment. We present a one dimensional poroelastic model in which the solid skeleton is composed of a soft neo-Hookean background matrix and crimped fibrils which do not bear load (FIB model). As the tissue is stretched, fibrils are straightened and contribute to load bearing. The fibre-reinforced tissue is compared to a tissue with a purely neo-Hookean (NH) skeleton in response to a uniaxial constant applied load (loading) and release of the load (unloading). The system dynamics are governed by a diffusion equation where the diffusion coefficient depends on stiffness. Within tendon parameter ranges, the FIB model is softer than the NH model, and so approaches steady state more slowly during loading. The presence of crimped fibrils allows the tendon to stretch further without excessively straining the fibrils or the NCM, providing a natural protection mechanism for the tendon's structural components to load, in agreement with experiments. During unloading, the FIB model is much slower to relax as the tissue softens due to fibril re-crimping. This asymmetry in loading and unloading manifests as a hysteresis loop in the stress-strain curve averaged over the tendon. The hysteresis is reduced with increasing applied load. The inclusion of fibrils allows for clearer biological interpretation and potential comparison to data. While the stress law employed in this study is bespoke for the application at hand by accounting for crimp and fibril recruitment, other fibril constitutive laws can readily be considered and incorporated into this framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：poroelastic model、one dimensional model、diffusion equation）；研究对象：肌腱（tendon）及其纤维卷曲（crimped fibre）在力学响应中的招募机制，具体为一种单轴多孔弹性模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 包含卷曲纤维的肌腱模型（FIB模型）在加载时比纯neo-Hookean模型更软、达到稳态更慢；卸载时因纤维重新卷曲而松弛更慢，导致应力-应变曲线出现滞后回线，且滞后随加载增大而减小。卷曲纤维为肌腱结构组件提供了自然保护机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：包含卷曲纤维的肌腱模型（FIB模型）在加载时比纯neo-Hookean模型更软、达到稳态更慢；卸载时因纤维重新卷曲而松弛更慢，导致应力-应变曲线出现滞后回线，且滞后随加载增大而减小。卷曲纤维为肌腱结构组件提供了自然保护机制。；创新点：首次在多孔弹性肌腱模型中引入卷曲纤维的招募机制（crimped fibre recruitment），而此前相关研究未包含这一特征。
papers.method_zh: 一维多孔弹性理论模型，固体骨架由软neo-Hookean背景基质和初始不承力的卷曲原纤维组成（FIB模型），系统动力学由扩散方程控制（扩散系数依赖于刚度），并与纯neo-Hookean骨架（NH模型）进行对比。

papers.title: Typical geometry of self-repelling polymers in a constant force field
papers.abstract: We study a general class of self-repelling polymers on $\mathbb Z^2$, including the simple random walk, the self-avoiding walk and the repulsive Domb-Joyce model, in the presence of a constant force field acting on each monomer. Conditioning the polymer to have fixed length and fixed endpoints, we identify the limiting free energy and prove that typical trajectories concentrate exponentially near a deterministic macroscopic shape. This shape is characterized as the unique minimizer of a variational problem and can be interpreted as a geodesic of a height-dependent Finsler metric. We also analyze two limiting regimes with universal features: for small field strength, in the symmetric case, the geodesic is close to a classical catenary, while for large field strength it converges to a universal polygonal shape governed by the nearest-neighbor lattice constraint.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“identify the limiting free energy”“prove that typical trajectories concentrate”“characterized as the unique minimizer of a variational problem”等，属于严格的数学物理理论分析。；研究对象：二维平方晶格（ℤ²）上受恒定力场作用的一类自排斥聚合物，包括简单随机游走、自回避游走和排斥型Domb-Joyce模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在固定聚合物长度和端点条件下，典型轨迹会指数级地集中在一个确定性的宏观形状附近；该形状是某个变分问题的唯一极小值，可解释为依赖于高度的Finsler度量下的测地线。在小场强对称情形下该形状接近经典悬链线，在大场强下则收敛为由最近邻晶格约束决定的通用多边形形状。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在固定聚合物长度和端点条件下，典型轨迹会指数级地集中在一个确定性的宏观形状附近；该形状是某个变分问题的唯一极小值，可解释为依赖于高度的Finsler度量下的测地线。在小场强对称情形下该形状接近经典悬链线，在大场强下则收敛为由最近邻晶格约束决定的通用多边形形状。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用大偏差理论与变分法，通过识别自由能的极限并证明轨迹的指数集中性，将宏观形状刻画为变分问题的唯一极小值，并分析小场强与大场强两个极限下的普适行为。

papers.title: Investigating causality between principal components in protein dynamics
papers.abstract: Principal component analysis (PCA) is widely used to characterize collective protein motions from molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. While PCA identifies the dominant modes of structural fluctuation, it does not reveal whether different principal components (PCs) causally influence each other. Here, we investigate this question using a recently introduced causal-discovery framework [Del Tatto et al, PNAS 2024], which allows to infer putative causal asymmetries between high-dimensional time series. We apply this approach to long-timescale MD trajectories of two proteins. By analyzing relationships among PCs, we construct directed networks describing how PCs influence one another across time scales. These directional relationships, whose existence is a necessary condition for the presence of a causal link, are not captured by conventional covariance-based analyses and provide information that is complementary to PCA and Time-lagged Independent Component Analysis (TICA). Our results suggest that our causal inference approach can uncover previously hidden aspects of the dynamical organization of protein motions and offer a new perspective on this very popular class of collective variables.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用了分子动力学（MD）模拟和因果发现框架进行数据分析。；研究对象：蛋白质动力学。具体研究蛋白质分子动力学模拟中，不同主成分（PCs）之间的因果关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过因果发现框架，揭示了蛋白质动力学中不同主成分之间存在有向的、跨时间尺度的相互影响关系。这种方向性关系是传统协方差分析无法捕捉的，为理解蛋白质运动的动态组织提供了新视角。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过因果发现框架，揭示了蛋白质动力学中不同主成分之间存在有向的、跨时间尺度的相互影响关系。这种方向性关系是传统协方差分析无法捕捉的，为理解蛋白质运动的动态组织提供了新视角。；创新点：将因果推断方法应用于蛋白质动力学的主成分分析（PCA）中，揭示了传统PCA和时间滞后独立成分分析（TICA）无法提供的、主成分之间的因果不对称性信息。
papers.method_zh: 采用了Del Tatto等人（PNAS 2024）提出的因果发现框架，对两种蛋白质的长时程分子动力学（MD）轨迹进行分析。具体通过分析主成分（PCs）之间的关系，构建了描述PCs如何相互影响的有向网络。

papers.title: Recursive behavior in a diatomic FPUT lattice
papers.abstract: We study the diatomic FPUT lattice with cubic anharmonic potential, and analyze the recurrent behaviour of its solutions. We find that two distinct types of recurrence occur. One type is the classic FPUT recurrence; for such recurrence, we find that the relation between recurrence period and nonlinear strength is similar to that in the monatomic case. The other type, which cannot exist in the monatomic lattice, is the recurrence due to the interactions between modes in the two branches of the dispersion relation. Indeed, we prove the existence of the optical-acoustical-acoustical resonant interaction between three Fourier modes for which a recurrent behavior in the distribution of the energy is observed. In addition, we develop a reduced Fourier-space dynamical model that reproduces the same recurrent behavior. We assess the robustness of our results through numerical simulations of the diatomic Toda lattice and the diatomic granular chain; in both cases, the same recursive behavior is observed. Finally, in the continuous limit, we derive from the diatomic model a system of three coupled PDEs which are known to be integrable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“证明存在”、“推导出”、“发展了一个约化动力学模型”，并进行了“数值模拟”验证。；研究对象：双原子FPUT（Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou）晶格，具体为具有三次非谐势的双原子链。研究其解的递归行为（recurrent behaviour）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双原子FPUT晶格中存在两种不同类型的能量递归行为：一种是经典的单原子FPUT递归，其递归周期与非线性强度的关系与单原子情况类似；另一种是双原子晶格特有的、由色散关系中光学支和声学支模式间相互作用导致的递归，具体源于光学-声学-声学（optical-acoustical-acoustical）三波共振相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双原子FPUT晶格中存在两种不同类型的能量递归行为：一种是经典的单原子FPUT递归，其递归周期与非线性强度的关系与单原子情况类似；另一种是双原子晶格特有的、由色散关系中光学支和声学支模式间相互作用导致的递归，具体源于光学-声学-声学（optical-acoustical-acoustical）三波共振相互作用。；创新点：发现了双原子FPUT晶格中一种不同于单原子情况的新型递归行为，该行为源于光学支与声学支模式间的共振相互作用，并建立了相应的约化模型和连续极限下的可积PDE系统。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **理论分析**：对双原子FPUT晶格模型进行解析分析，证明了三波共振相互作用的存在，并推导了描述该递归行为的约化傅里叶空间动力学模型。

papers.title: Initial-state-dependent dephasing effect in non-Hermitian Su-Schrieffer-Heeger models
papers.abstract: Understanding the dynamical evolution of non-Hermitian systems under extra external dissipation is essential. Dephasing, a major realistic dissipation, is conventionally considered detrimental to information processing. However, its impact on non-Hermitian systems remains largely unexplored. Here, we focus on finite-sized non-Hermitian Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) lattice models with alternating gain and loss in real space and examine the dynamical evolution of the trace distance under pure dephasing. By tuning system parameters, this model supports phases with either parity-time or anti-parity-time symmetries, enabling us to explore the interplay between dephasing and different non-Hermitian symmetries. While the trace distance exhibits distinct dynamical behaviors across the different phases in the absence of dephasing, its response to dephasing is largely symmetry-independent but instead initial-state dependent. By varying initial states, we observe that increasing the dephasing strength can either merely accelerate the decay of the trace distance or stabilize it. Interestingly, we reveal two kinds of dephasing-induced stabilization that differ in the strong dephasing limit: a partial stabilization, where the trace distance approaches a finite value smaller than its initial value in the long-time limit, and a complete stabilization, where the trace distance remains at its initial value throughout the entire evolution. By analyzing the equation of motion, we attribute the initial-state dependent dephasing effect to the alternating gain and loss in the system and confirm its absence in Hermitian counterparts. Furthermore, in the anti-parity-time symmetry unbroken phase, we identify a continuous suppression-upon increasing the dephasing strength-of the otherwise exponential decay of the trace distance seen in the absence of dephasing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：examine the dynamical evolution、analyzing the equation of motion、theoretical framework。；研究对象：非厄米Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）晶格模型，具体研究该模型在纯退相干（dephasing）作用下的动力学演化，以及其与宇称-时间（PT）对称性和反宇称-时间（anti-PT）对称性的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非厄米SSH模型中，退相干效应主要依赖于初始态的选择，而非系统的对称性。通过改变初始态，增强退相干强度既可以加速迹距离的衰减，也可以使其稳定化，并在强退相干极限下发现了部分稳定化和完全稳定化两种不同的稳定机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非厄米SSH模型中，退相干效应主要依赖于初始态的选择，而非系统的对称性。通过改变初始态，增强退相干强度既可以加速迹距离的衰减，也可以使其稳定化，并在强退相干极限下发现了部分稳定化和完全稳定化两种不同的稳定机制。；创新点：揭示了非厄米系统中退相干效应的初始态依赖性，并发现了两种不同的退相干诱导稳定化现象（部分稳定化与完全稳定化），这些现象在厄米对应系统中不存在。此外，在反PT对称性未破缺相中，首次观察到退相干强度对原本指数衰减的迹距离的连续抑制效应。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体包括：构建有限尺寸的非厄米SSH晶格模型（实空间交替增益与损耗），计算纯退相干下迹距离（trace distance）的动力学演化，并通过分析运动方程（equation of motion）解释退相干效应的初始态依赖性。

papers.title: Cyclic Denoising Reveals Ultrastable Memories in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: We introduce cyclic denoising -- repeated forward and reverse diffusion at controlled noise amplitudes -- as an extraction attack for image diffusion models. Inspired by random organization in disordered solids, cyclic denoising exposes regions of the learned distribution that are largely inaccessible to standard sampling. The dynamics drive samples toward attractors with a broad stability spectrum. The deepest attractors are ultrastable: they regenerate after near-total corruption and persist through thousands of noising-denoising cycles. Many of these attractors correspond to memorized training images, including stock photographs, brand watermarks, and web-crawl artifacts. The attack requires only sampler-level control, with no gradients, weight inspection, prompts, captions, or prior knowledge of the training data. Unlike generate-and-filter attacks, which rely on large-scale prompted generation and post-hoc similarity or membership-inference filtering, our main protocol is fully unconditioned. We demonstrate the phenomenon in Stable Diffusion v1.4 and in a pixel-space DDPM, showing consistent behavior across latent- and pixel-space diffusion models. Across noise amplitudes, we observe a yielding-like transition: low-amplitude cycling produces trivial absorbing fixed points or limit cycles, while larger amplitudes induce rearrangements, basin hopping, and long-lived trapping in structured memorized attractor basins. We also observe hierarchical partial absorption, prompt-stabilized basins, and cross-initial-condition universality of the recovered attractor set. Our results therefore show that cyclic denoising is both a physics-inspired probe of generative landscapes and a practical tool for memorization auditing, with implications for privacy, copyright compliance, and model fingerprinting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算与理论结合）。关键词：extraction attack（提取攻击）、dynamics（动力学）、attractor（吸引子）、generative landscapes（生成景观）。；研究对象：扩散模型（Stable Diffusion v1.4 和像素空间 DDPM）中的记忆效应与生成景观，具体物理现象为循环去噪过程中样本的吸引子行为与超稳定记忆态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 循环去噪（cyclic denoising）能够揭示扩散模型中存在超稳定吸引子（ultrastable attractors），这些吸引子对应训练数据中的记忆图像（如库存照片、品牌水印等），可在近完全破坏后再生并经受数千次噪声-去噪循环。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：循环去噪（cyclic denoising）能够揭示扩散模型中存在超稳定吸引子（ultrastable attractors），这些吸引子对应训练数据中的记忆图像（如库存照片、品牌水印等），可在近完全破坏后再生并经受数千次噪声-去噪循环。；创新点：将无序固体中的随机组织（random organization）概念引入扩散模型分析，首次发现并系统表征了循环去噪下的“屈服转变”（yielding-like transition）——低幅度循环产生平凡固定点或极限环，高幅度循环导致重排、盆地跳跃和长寿命俘获于结构化记忆吸引子。该方法同时作为无需条件生成的记忆审计工具，对隐私、版权合规和模型指纹识别具有实际意义。
papers.method_zh: 提出循环去噪协议：在受控噪声幅度下重复执行前向扩散（加噪）和反向扩散（去噪）过程。该方法无需梯度、权重检查、提示词或训练数据先验知识，仅需采样器级控制。对比了潜空间（Stable Diffusion v1.4）和像素空间（DDPM）模型，并系统扫描不同噪声幅度下的动力学行为。

papers.title: Dual-isotope narrow-line MOT of dysprosium by phase modulation
papers.abstract: We report on the characterization of a narrow-line magneto-optical trap (MOT), where two different isotopes of the dysprosium (Dy) atom can be simultaneously loaded and trapped. We rely on phase modulation via high-power, free-space electro-optic modulators (EOMs) to generate optical sidebands at the correct detuning for two different isotopes. This technique is applied on the slowing transition at 421 nm and the MOT transition at 626 nm. Using modular resonant electronic circuits, we match the sideband separation to the isotope shift among the two target isotopes, realizing mixtures of the bosonic isotopes 164Dy -162Dy and 162Dy -160Dy. We exploit the interplay between radiation forces and gravity in the narrow-line MOT to control the spatial position of the two isotopes with the EOM drive frequency. We demonstrate full control of the isotopic mixture with the EOM drive, offering new and cost-effective capabilities for controlling mixtures of atomic species that can be trapped in a narrow-line MOT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：characterization（表征）、phase modulation（相位调制）、electro-optic modulators（电光调制器）、demonstrate（演示）。；研究对象：镝（Dy）原子的窄线宽磁光阱（MOT），具体研究两种不同同位素（如¹⁶⁴Dy-¹⁶²Dy、¹⁶²Dy-¹⁶⁰Dy）的同时装载与囚禁。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过相位调制技术，利用自由空间电光调制器（EOM）在减速跃迁（421 nm）和MOT跃迁（626 nm）上产生正确的边带频率，实现了两种镝同位素的同时囚禁，并可通过调节EOM驱动频率控制两种同位素在MOT中的空间位置。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过相位调制技术，利用自由空间电光调制器（EOM）在减速跃迁（421 nm）和MOT跃迁（626 nm）上产生正确的边带频率，实现了两种镝同位素的同时囚禁，并可通过调节EOM驱动频率控制两种同位素在MOT中的空间位置。；创新点：首次利用相位调制技术（而非传统独立激光器）实现窄线宽MOT中两种镝同位素的同时装载与空间位置控制，提供了一种经济高效的同位素混合物操控新方案。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：使用高功率自由空间电光调制器（EOM）产生光学边带，配合模块化谐振电子电路匹配同位素频移；利用窄线宽MOT中辐射力与重力的相互作用，通过EOM驱动频率调控同位素空间分布。

papers.title: Augmenting Imaginary-Time Evolution with Local Geometric Information
papers.abstract: Imaginary-time evolution (ITE) underpins a broad family of algorithms for ground-state preparation in quantum simulation and quantum many-body physics. In these methods, convergence is governed by the energy variance of the instantaneous state, causing the flow to approach the ground state only asymptotically. We introduce an augmented imaginary-time evolution (AITE) framework that replaces the standard gradient flow on the energy landscape with a geometrically informed descent along locally optimal directions, which are identified by exploiting the higher-order statistical structure of the instantaneous energy distribution. The resulting flow strictly outperforms standard ITE throughout the entire evolution and exhibits two qualitatively distinct regimes: a superlinear convergence regime, followed by an extinction regime in which the energy error vanishes exactly at a finite imaginary time, in sharp contrast to the asymptotic exponential decay of ITE. Standard ITE is recovered in the zero-skewness limit of AITE, implying that the acceleration extends naturally across the broader ITE algorithmic family.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：framework、flow、convergence regime。；研究对象：量子模拟与量子多体物理中的基态制备问题，具体为虚时间演化（ITE）算法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种增强型虚时间演化（AITE）框架，利用能量分布的高阶统计结构实现局部最优下降方向，使能量误差在有限虚时间内精确归零（灭绝区），而非标准ITE的渐近指数衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种增强型虚时间演化（AITE）框架，利用能量分布的高阶统计结构实现局部最优下降方向，使能量误差在有限虚时间内精确归零（灭绝区），而非标准ITE的渐近指数衰减。；创新点：首次将局部几何信息（高阶统计结构）引入虚时间演化，实现了超线性收敛与有限时间精确归零的灭绝区，且标准ITE在AITE的零偏度极限下自然恢复，表明加速机制可推广至整个ITE算法家族。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：在能量景观上引入几何信息引导的下降流，通过瞬时能量分布的高阶统计结构（如偏度）识别局部最优方向，替代标准梯度流。

papers.title: Wavelet Matrix Product States for Quantum Fields
papers.abstract: We introduce a variational method to solve continuum quantum models with discrete tensor network techniques. The method leverages wavelet matrix product states (wMPS): matrix product states built on top of sufficiently regular ($N\geq 6$) Daubechies scaling functions. These states live in the continuum field theory Fock space, have finite energy density, and can be optimized with standard algorithms, without restriction to free theories. Further, exploiting the multi-resolution analysis built into wavelets, and its quantum circuit description, we can iteratively refine wMPS to obtain accurate approximations at arbitrarily fine length-scales. We showcase the efficiency of the method on the Lieb-Liniger model, computing energy density and correlation functions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：variational method（变分法）、tensor network techniques（张量网络技术）、matrix product states（矩阵乘积态）。；研究对象：连续场论中的量子模型，具体以 Lieb-Liniger 模型（一维相互作用玻色子体系）为例进行验证。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出基于小波矩阵乘积态（wMPS）的变分方法，能够直接在连续场论 Fock 空间中求解量子模型，并通过多分辨率分析实现任意精细尺度的精确近似，在 Lieb-Liniger 模型上成功计算了能量密度和关联函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出基于小波矩阵乘积态（wMPS）的变分方法，能够直接在连续场论 Fock 空间中求解量子模型，并通过多分辨率分析实现任意精细尺度的精确近似，在 Lieb-Liniger 模型上成功计算了能量密度和关联函数。；创新点：将小波变换的多分辨率特性与矩阵乘积态结合，使得张量网络方法能够直接处理连续场论中的无限维希尔伯特空间，并实现从粗到精的尺度自适应优化。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Daubechies 小波（正则性 N≥6）的尺度函数构建矩阵乘积态（wMPS），利用小波的多分辨率分析及其量子电路描述，通过标准张量网络优化算法（如 DMRG 类算法）对 wMPS 进行迭代细化，无需限制于自由理论。

papers.title: Infinite-Level Hierarchy of Solvable Quantum Circuits
papers.abstract: Dual-unitary circuits have emerged as a paradigm of exactly solvable yet non-integrable quantum dynamics. Recently, a generalization of dual unitarity attempting to extend the phenomenology of exactly solvable circuits has been introduced through a hierarchy of conditions, with dual unitarity as the first level. However, beyond the second level the proposed generalized dual-unitary hierarchy ceases to be solvable in the whole spacetime. We present an infinite hierarchy of solvability conditions remedying this problem. These new conditions can be combined with the generalized dual-unitary hierarchy to obtain circuits for which correlation functions and entanglement dynamics can be analyzed exactly in the whole spacetime. We show that this novel hierarchy possesses non-trivial solutions at every level. Our results demonstrate that dual unitarity can be systematically extended while preserving solvability, opening up investigations of exactly solvable non-integrable systems with more general properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exactly solvable、hierarchy of conditions、solvability conditions。；研究对象：量子电路中的“双幺正电路”（dual-unitary circuits）及其推广——可解量子电路的分层结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种无限层次的“可解性条件”层级，可与广义双幺正层级结合，使得关联函数和纠缠动力学在整个时空上精确可解，且每一层级都存在非平凡解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种无限层次的“可解性条件”层级，可与广义双幺正层级结合，使得关联函数和纠缠动力学在整个时空上精确可解，且每一层级都存在非平凡解。；创新点：解决了此前广义双幺正层级在第二层之后无法在全时空可解的问题，首次构建了无限层次的可解性层级，系统性地扩展了双幺正性，同时保持可解性。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于广义双幺正层级（generalized dual-unitary hierarchy）的扩展，引入新的可解性条件（solvability conditions），通过数学构造证明每一层级存在非平凡解，并分析其可解性。

papers.title: Controlled Chaos in 4D SCFTs
papers.abstract: Chaotic dynamics play an important role in a number of physical systems. One of the qualitative hallmarks of this behavior is the appearance of a sufficiently "complex" spectrum of energy levels. This also makes it challenging to directly verify the onset of chaos in interacting quantum field theories. We present a class of 4D superconformal field theories (SCFTs) given by orbifolds of 4D $\mathcal{N} = 4$ Super Yang--Mills theory in which operator mixing in a controlled subsector is described by an effective spin chain in one spatial dimension with nearest neighbor interactions tuned by the marginal couplings of the SCFT. Tuning the marginal couplings results in a chaotic spectrum, while generically the spin chain exhibits Anderson localization. We diagnose the onset of chaos by analyzing the statistical distribution of eigenvalues of the dilatation operator, in particular properties such as eigenvalue level repulsion, spectral rigidity, and the spectral form factor. We also show that other diagnostics such as Krylov complexity sometimes do not faithfully capture this information. This structure defines a chaotic billiard in the target space of the stringy realization. We also comment on the large $N$ holographic dual description, where the controlled single spin chain approximation must be supplemented by multi-trace dynamics, i.e., the splitting and joining of multiple spin chains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：superconformal field theories、orbifolds、spin chain、holographic dual。；研究对象：4维超共形场论（4D SCFTs）中的混沌动力学，具体通过4D 𝒩=4超杨-米尔斯理论的轨道流形（orbifold）实现，并利用有效自旋链模型描述其算子混合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节SCFT中的边际耦合，系统可从安德森局域化过渡到混沌谱；混沌的判据（如能级排斥、谱刚性、谱形因子）比Krylov复杂度更可靠地刻画混沌行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节SCFT中的边际耦合，系统可从安德森局域化过渡到混沌谱；混沌的判据（如能级排斥、谱刚性、谱形因子）比Krylov复杂度更可靠地刻画混沌行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：构造轨道流形SCFT，将其中的算子混合映射为具有最近邻相互作用的一维自旋链；通过分析膨胀算子的本征值统计分布（能级排斥、谱刚性、谱形因子）诊断混沌；并讨论Krylov复杂度的适用性。

papers.title: On the temperature dependence of quasinormal modes in SYK and holography
papers.abstract: It was recently found that the quasinormal modes (or Ruelle--Pollicott resonances) of the SYK model at infinite temperature form a Christmas tree shape, reminiscent of AdS black holes. We generalise this computation to finite temperature, allowing us to continuously connect the infinite temperature results to the low temperature regime dual to JT gravity. We contrast the movement of the quasinormal modes with a few examples: various AdS black holes, dynamical phase transitions, and the large $p$ SYK chain. We find that the relaxation rate increases monotonically with temperature only at strong coupling, corresponding to the gravitational regime. Byproducts of our investigations are new results on operator growth that may be of independent interest.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quasinormal modes、SYK model、holography、JT gravity。；研究对象：SYK模型（Sachdev–Ye–Kitaev模型）的准正则模（Ruelle–Pollicott共振）的温度依赖性，以及其与全息对偶（AdS黑洞、JT引力）的对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强耦合（引力对应）区域，弛豫率随温度单调增加；通过将计算推广至有限温度，可将无限温度结果与低温JT引力对偶区域连续连接。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强耦合（引力对应）区域，弛豫率随温度单调增加；通过将计算推广至有限温度，可将无限温度结果与低温JT引力对偶区域连续连接。；创新点：首次系统研究了SYK模型准正则模从无限温度到低温（JT引力对偶）的连续温度依赖行为，并揭示了弛豫率随温度单调增加仅出现在强耦合（引力）区域这一特征；此外，还得到了关于算符增长的新结果。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算：将SYK模型准正则模的计算从无限温度推广到有限温度，并与多种AdS黑洞、动力学相变及大p SYK链的准正则模行为进行对比分析。

papers.title: Emergent Andreev Reflection from a Lattice Duality Defect
papers.abstract: Andreev reflection converts an incoming fermion into an outgoing hole and is usually tied to a superconducting interface. We show that an analogous charge-conjugating boundary condition emerges from a purely lattice duality defect. Starting from a Majorana representation of the transverse-field Ising chain, we construct a folded lattice model in which a boundary Majorana impurity implements a one-site translation of a staggered Majorana chain. In the continuum, this translation becomes a chiral fermion-parity defect: it flips the sign of the only left-moving Majorana mode while leaving the right-moving mode unchanged. When the two Majorana modes are recombined into a complex fermion in the folded geometry, this sign flip becomes the Andreev-like boundary condition. Our lattice formulation gives a microscopic interpretation of the Emery--Kivelson boundary of the two-channel Kondo problem and of Maldacena--Ludwig monopole scattering, while identifying the boundary as the interface between a Kitaev-chain SPT phase and a gapless chain. The same Majorana translation defect also provides a lattice realization of an axial $U(1)_A$-symmetric charge-flip boundary.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：lattice duality defect、Majorana representation、continuum limit、boundary condition。；研究对象：研究由晶格对偶缺陷（lattice duality defect）所导致的类安德烈夫反射（Andreev-like reflection）边界条件，具体体系为横场伊辛链（transverse-field Ising chain）的马约拉纳表示及其折叠晶格模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明纯晶格对偶缺陷可以产生类似超导界面的电荷共轭边界条件，即入射费米子转化为出射空穴；该缺陷在连续极限下表现为手征费米子宇称缺陷，在折叠几何中重组为复费米子后形成类安德烈夫边界条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明纯晶格对偶缺陷可以产生类似超导界面的电荷共轭边界条件，即入射费米子转化为出射空穴；该缺陷在连续极限下表现为手征费米子宇称缺陷，在折叠几何中重组为复费米子后形成类安德烈夫边界条件。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用马约拉纳费米子表示构建横场伊辛链的折叠晶格模型，引入边界马约拉纳杂质实现交错马约拉纳链的单格点平移，并通过连续极限分析将平移操作映射为手征费米子宇称缺陷，最终在折叠几何中重组为复费米子并导出边界条件。

papers.title: Effective hyperuniformity in time-integrated stochastic Turing patterns
papers.abstract: Demographic noise generates stochastic Turing patterns even when reaction-diffusion systems are deterministically stable. We show analytically and verify numerically in the Levin-Segel model that temporal integration of configurations reveals emergent large-scale organization. The intensive number variance in a window of size $R \gg 1$ approaches a finite reaction-kinetic floor as $1/R$, over a spatial range growing by orders of magnitude near the Turing instability. This yields an effectively hyperuniform, fine-tuning-free regime previously unidentified in non-conserved multispecies stochastic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值验证）。关键词：analytically show, verify numerically。；研究对象：随机图灵斑图（stochastic Turing patterns）在时间积分下的有效超均匀性（effective hyperuniformity），具体以Levin-Segel模型为研究对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在确定性稳定的反应-扩散系统中，人口噪声可产生随机图灵斑图；对构型进行时间积分后，系统展现出大尺度组织，其强度数方差在窗口尺寸R≫1时以1/R趋近于一个有限的反应动力学下限，从而在非守恒多物种随机系统中实现无需精细调谐的有效超均匀态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在确定性稳定的反应-扩散系统中，人口噪声可产生随机图灵斑图；对构型进行时间积分后，系统展现出大尺度组织，其强度数方差在窗口尺寸R≫1时以1/R趋近于一个有限的反应动力学下限，从而在非守恒多物种随机系统中实现无需精细调谐的有效超均匀态。；创新点：首次在非守恒多物种随机系统中识别出无需精细调谐即可实现的有效超均匀性区域，该区域在图灵失稳附近空间尺度可增长数个数量级。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导（analytically）与数值模拟（numerically verify）相结合，基于Levin-Segel模型进行分析。

papers.title: Resolving support-mismatch by local basis rotation in variational Monte Carlo
papers.abstract: Real-time dynamics after a local quench by a charged operator encodes the response functions measured in spectroscopic experiments, yet they have long posed a challenge for variational Monte Carlo calculations. The obstacle is a support mismatch: the projective action by a charged local operator forces an exponentially large number of configurations to vanish, but these configurations may still contribute to the dynamics, biasing the estimators and freezing the evolution at the very first step. This difficulty is an artifact of the chosen sampling basis, and the support mismatch generated by a charged local operator is itself local. We demonstrate that the missing support can be restored by a local rotation of the sampling basis, without changing the underlying variational dynamics. We propose a local basis-rotation sampling scheme that resolves the support-mismatch problem and can be readily incorporated into existing variational Monte Carlo algorithms. Benchmarks show that rotation sampling accurately captures long-time quantum dynamics, enabling variational Monte Carlo calculations of dynamical structure factors in one dimension and unbiased local-operator quench dynamics in two dimensions. We also show that this resolution of the support-mismatch problem extends beyond real-time dynamics, and may also be helpful for ground state variational Monte Carlo calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：variational Monte Carlo calculations、benchmarks、sampling scheme）；研究对象：变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）计算中由带电局域算符引发的“支撑失配”（support-mismatch）问题，以及该问题对实时动力学和动力学结构因子计算的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过局域基矢旋转采样方案，可以恢复因带电局域算符投影而丢失的构型支撑，从而准确捕捉长时间量子动力学，并实现一维动力学结构因子和二维无偏局域算符淬火动力学的VMC计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过局域基矢旋转采样方案，可以恢复因带电局域算符投影而丢失的构型支撑，从而准确捕捉长时间量子动力学，并实现一维动力学结构因子和二维无偏局域算符淬火动力学的VMC计算。；创新点：首次识别并解决了VMC中带电局域算符淬火动力学计算中的支撑失配问题，提出了一种局域且易于实现的基矢旋转采样方法，并证明该方法不仅适用于实时动力学，还可用于基态VMC计算。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种局域基矢旋转采样方案（local basis-rotation sampling scheme），该方案在不改变底层变分动力学的前提下，通过局域旋转采样基矢来修复支撑失配问题，并可直接集成到现有VMC算法中。

papers.title: Fundamental Limits of Stability Inference in High-Dimensional Complex Systems
papers.abstract: Many complex systems, including ecosystems, neural circuits, and financial markets, are inferred to operate close to a threshold of instability, at which a small perturbation can propagate across the entire system. This proximity is often interpreted as functionally advantageous, yet it poses a question common to all these fields: from a finite, noisy recording, how precisely can the distance of a system from that threshold be estimated? Using the multivariate Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process as the canonical linear model of relaxation near a stable fixed point, we show that the attainable precision is governed by three factors: an effective measurement budget, set by the number of samples relative to the system dimension and the sampling interval; the signal-to-noise ratio, given by the magnitude of deterministic interactions relative to stochastic forcing; and the distance to criticality, which simultaneously sets the system's correlation times and degrades both of the preceding factors. As the slowest dynamical mode softens near the threshold, the curvature of the log-likelihood flattens along the direction that determines stability, so that the relative uncertainty on the estimated distance diverges as that distance vanishes. Critically, temporal correlations near instability reduce the effective number of independent observations far below the nominal sample count, and inference breaks down when this effective count falls below the system dimension, even when the raw data volume appears sufficient. A direct consequence is the existence of an optimal sampling interval that diverges as the system approaches criticality, with practical implications for experimental design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show that、governed by、theoretical framework（基于多变量Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程的线性模型分析）。；研究对象：高维复杂系统的稳定性推断极限。具体物理现象包括生态系统、神经回路和金融市场等系统在接近失稳阈值时的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从有限、含噪的观测数据中估计系统到失稳阈值的距离，其精度受限于有效测量预算、信噪比和到临界点的距离三个因素。当系统接近临界点时，相对不确定性发散，且时间相关性会大幅降低有效独立观测数，导致推断失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从有限、含噪的观测数据中估计系统到失稳阈值的距离，其精度受限于有效测量预算、信噪比和到临界点的距离三个因素。当系统接近临界点时，相对不确定性发散，且时间相关性会大幅降低有效独立观测数，导致推断失效。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用多变量Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程作为在稳定不动点附近弛豫的典型线性模型，通过分析对数似然函数的曲率，推导出估计精度的理论极限。

papers.title: Application of Machine Learning for the Identification of 2D Colloidal Assemblies: A Case Study on Particles of Distinct Shapes
papers.abstract: This work addresses the problem of identifying colloidal monolayer assemblies using particles of various shapes (two-dimensional coatings): spheres, ellipsoids, cuboids, and rods. The following classification of assemblies is considered: isolated particles, dimers, chains, clusters, and loops. The YOLO model was chosen as the identification method. Synthetic datasets were prepared for each of the four particle shapes to train the models. The paper discusses the application of models trained on synthetic data to experimental images. An analysis was carried out on the feasibility of using such models for recognizing configurations in real images. While recognition on artificial images is nearly perfect, tests on experimental images showed a significant deviation. The average error across all particle types was 43.1%, but a considerable spread in values is observed: from 20% for spheres to 58.5% for cuboids, indicating the algorithm's selective sensitivity to object geometry. The created datasets and trained models are freely available for use. The corresponding modules have been integrated into the previously developed information system (https://isanm.space/). To further improve prediction results, it is necessary to prepare datasets based on experimental images.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合类型。判断依据：涉及实验图像（experimental images）与合成数据集（synthetic datasets）的对比，以及机器学习模型（YOLO model）的训练与应用。；研究对象：二维胶体单层组装体（2D colloidal monolayer assemblies），具体包括不同形状的颗粒：球体（spheres）、椭球体（ellipsoids）、长方体（cuboids）和棒状体（rods），以及其形成的构型：孤立颗粒、二聚体、链、团簇和环。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于合成数据训练的YOLO模型在识别人工图像时近乎完美，但在实验图像上平均误差高达43.1%，且误差对颗粒几何形状敏感：球体误差最低（20%），长方体误差最高（58.5%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于合成数据训练的YOLO模型在识别人工图像时近乎完美，但在实验图像上平均误差高达43.1%，且误差对颗粒几何形状敏感：球体误差最低（20%），长方体误差最高（58.5%）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用YOLO（You Only Look Once）目标检测模型作为识别方法；为四种不同形状的颗粒分别制备合成数据集（synthetic datasets）用于模型训练；将训练后的模型应用于实验图像进行识别测试，并统计误差。

papers.title: Reentrant superconductivity enabled by spin-orbit coupling: Application to UTe$_2$
papers.abstract: Reentrant superconductivity has been understood primarily in terms of the Jaccarino-Peter field-compensation effect or from a change of the strength in the pairing interaction. However, neither mechanism appears able to entirely explain the remarkable phase diagram of UTe$_2$. Here we propose a generic theory of the field-enhancement of opposite-spin Cooper pairings which does not necessitate the coexistence of magnetism or the vicinity of a magnetic quantum critical point. Our analytical treatment shows that the reentrance has its origin in the interplay of the sublattice degrees of freedom and spin-orbit coupling, which can can strikingly enhance opposite-spin Cooper pairings at strong Zeeman fields. Based on these results, we show that a pairing state with B$_{3u}$ symmetry can reproduce the highly anisotropic phase diagram of the reentrant superconducting state of UTe$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“generic theory”、“analytical treatment”、“propose”。；研究对象：UTe₂ 中的重入超导现象，特别是其高度各向异性的相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种不依赖磁性共存或磁量子临界点的一般性理论，指出自旋-轨道耦合与子晶格自由度的相互作用可在强塞曼场下显著增强反向自旋库珀配对，从而解释 UTe₂ 中的重入超导行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种不依赖磁性共存或磁量子临界点的一般性理论，指出自旋-轨道耦合与子晶格自由度的相互作用可在强塞曼场下显著增强反向自旋库珀配对，从而解释 UTe₂ 中的重入超导行为。；创新点：提出了不同于传统 Jaccarino-Peter 场补偿效应或配对相互作用强度变化的全新重入超导机制，且不要求体系存在磁性或靠近磁量子临界点。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论分析，基于子晶格自由度与自旋-轨道耦合的相互作用，推导出强塞曼场下反向自旋库珀配对的增强机制，并利用 B₃u 对称性的配对态重现 UTe₂ 重入超导态的高度各向异性相图。

papers.title: Two-dimensional stealthy hyperuniform polycrystalline disk packings
papers.abstract: Polycrystals consist of grains of local crystalline order separated by grain boundaries. Their structure is not hyperuniform, even though perfect crystals are, because polycrystals consist of randomly sized and oriented grains that generate appreciable long-wavelength density fluctuations. In this paper, we use a collective-coordinate optimization procedure to generate two-dimensional polycrystalline packings composed of identical disks arranged in a pattern that is ultradense, stealthy, and hyperuniform (hereafter named SHU). We compare them with polycrystalline disk packings obtained via a modified Lubachevsky--Stillinger rapid compression algorithm (hereafter named LS), a molecular dynamics protocol that serves as a standard reference model describing realistic, nonhyperuniform polycrystalline microstructures. We carry out an extensive comparison of polycrystalline SHU and LS packings that includes differences in two-point statistics, grain size, specific surface area, diffusion spreadability, and optical response as quantified by the imaginary part of the effective dynamic dielectric constant. We find that the polycrystalline SHU packings exhibit a distinctive grain-size distribution, a consequence of long-range correlations between different grains that is absent in the nonhyperuniform case. Within the nonlocal strong-contrast expansion, we confirm that polycrystalline SHU packings made of dielectric material are perfectly transparent to electromagnetic waves at small wave vectors, in contrast to LS packings. Moreover, polycrystalline SHU packings offer enhanced diffusion spreadability. Although polycrystalline SHU packings are not expected to form spontaneously in nature, they may be created for applications as metamaterials via nanolithography or 3D printing that take advantage of their distinctive optical and transport properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：collective-coordinate optimization procedure、molecular dynamics protocol、nonlocal strong-contrast expansion。；研究对象：二维多晶圆盘堆积体系，具体为“隐形超均匀”（stealthy hyperuniform, SHU）多晶堆积与通过Lubachevsky–Stillinger快速压缩算法（LS）生成的非超均匀多晶堆积。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过集体坐标优化生成的二维隐形超均匀多晶堆积（SHU）具有独特的晶粒尺寸分布（源于不同晶粒间的长程关联），在长波极限下对电磁波完全透明，并表现出增强的扩散传播性，而标准LS多晶堆积不具备这些性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过集体坐标优化生成的二维隐形超均匀多晶堆积（SHU）具有独特的晶粒尺寸分布（源于不同晶粒间的长程关联），在长波极限下对电磁波完全透明，并表现出增强的扩散传播性，而标准LS多晶堆积不具备这些性质。；创新点：首次实现了具有隐形超均匀特性的多晶堆积结构，并系统揭示了其与普通多晶堆积在统计、输运和光学性质上的本质差异，特别是长程关联导致的独特晶粒尺寸分布和长波透明性。
papers.method_zh: 采用集体坐标优化程序生成SHU多晶堆积；采用改进的Lubachevsky–Stillinger快速压缩算法（分子动力学协议）生成作为参考的非超均匀多晶堆积；通过两点统计、晶粒尺寸、比表面积、扩散传播性以及有效动态介电常数虚部（光学响应）进行对比分析；使用非局域强对比展开理论计算光学性质。

papers.title: Thermodynamic inference from noisy single-molecule time series
papers.abstract: Single-molecule or single-particle tracking measurements inherently yield noisy microscopic trajectories, often significantly constrained by the diffraction limit and by the finite rate at which photons are emitted and counted. Here we study systematically the resulting effects of finite spatial and temporal resolution on one's ability to discern and quantify the arrow of time in microscopic trajectories. Given an experimental time series Y(t) degraded by noise, we consider the problem of estimating the entropy production associated with the corresponding microscopic variable X(t) using two strategies. The first attempts to infer the statistical properties of X(t) from those of Y(t) before estimating the entropy production. The second uses the experimental observable as a proxy for the true microscopic observable, with the entropy production estimator applied directly to Y(t). We prove that both strategies result in lower bounds on the true entropy production. Importantly, noise-degraded observables Y(t) undergo non-Markovian dynamics even when X(t) are Markovian, and non-Markovian entropy production estimators are advantageous. We further note nontrivial interplay between spatial and temporal resolution: in the presence of detection noise, improving the temporal resolution alone may lead to poorer rather than better entropy production estimates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“研究系统性地”、“证明”、“考虑问题”等理论分析用语，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：单分子或单粒子追踪测量中，受有限空间分辨率（衍射极限）和有限时间分辨率（光子发射与计数速率）影响的微观轨迹，以及由此导致的熵产生估计问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在噪声退化的单分子时间序列中，无论采用何种策略估计熵产生，得到的都是真实熵产生的下界；且当微观过程为马尔可夫时，噪声观测量的动力学是非马尔可夫的，此时使用非马尔可夫熵产生估计器更有利。此外，空间与时间分辨率存在非平凡耦合：在存在探测噪声的情况下，单独提高时间分辨率反而可能导致熵产生估计变差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在噪声退化的单分子时间序列中，无论采用何种策略估计熵产生，得到的都是真实熵产生的下界；且当微观过程为马尔可夫时，噪声观测量的动力学是非马尔可夫的，此时使用非马尔可夫熵产生估计器更有利。此外，空间与时间分辨率存在非平凡耦合：在存在探测噪声的情况下，单独提高时间分辨率反而可能导致熵产生估计变差。；创新点：系统揭示了有限空间和时间分辨率对单分子轨迹时间箭头量化能力的综合影响，并证明了噪声退化观测量在马尔可夫微观过程下呈现非马尔可夫动力学，以及单独提升时间分辨率可能适得其反这一反直觉结论。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与证明。具体包括：对比两种熵产生估计策略（先推断微观变量统计特性再估计熵产生，以及直接用噪声观测量作为代理进行估计）；分析噪声观测量动力学性质（非马尔可夫性）；讨论空间与时间分辨率的相互影响。

papers.title: Data analysis methods for powder x-ray diffraction intensity under laser-driven dynamic compression at Omega and NIF laser facilities
papers.abstract: Powder x-ray diffraction (PXRD) under laser-driven dynamic compression is a powerful tool to investigate material response to extreme pressure, temperature and strain rates. Robust PXRD platforms have been developed at kJ and MJ laser facilities worldwide including the Powder X-Ray Diffraction Image Plate (PXRDIP) at the Omega Laser Facility at the Laboratory for Laser Energetics (LLE) and the TARget Diffraction In Situ (TARDIS) at the National Ignition Facility (NIF). Here we present further developments of data analysis methods focused towards improving the fidelity of the PXRD intensity determination for these platforms. We illustrate these methods by discussing how they can be implemented in a data analysis package and applied to shock compression data on diamond near 1 TPa. We discuss using the XRD signal from the collimating pinhole or a layer of un-compressed material in the sample package as \textit{ in-situ} references for XRD intensity. We detail how to compare data collected with different x-ray sources and how to account for thermal damping of XRD signal when comparing XRD from a shock-compressed, hot material with the reference material at ambient.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：laser-driven dynamic compression、powder x-ray diffraction (PXRD)、Omega Laser Facility、National Ignition Facility (NIF)。；研究对象：激光驱动动态压缩下粉末X射线衍射（PXRD）数据的分析方法，具体以金刚石在近1 TPa冲击压缩下的数据为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，主要聚焦于方法学进展：通过引入原位参考（如准直针孔或未压缩材料层的XRD信号）以及考虑热阻尼效应，提高了PXRD强度测定的保真度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，主要聚焦于方法学进展：通过引入原位参考（如准直针孔或未压缩材料层的XRD信号）以及考虑热阻尼效应，提高了PXRD强度测定的保真度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段为激光驱动动态压缩下的粉末X射线衍射（PXRD），具体平台包括Omega激光装置的PXRDIP和NIF的TARDIS。分析方法包括：利用准直针孔或样品包中未压缩材料层的XRD信号作为原位强度参考；比较不同X射线源采集的数据；在比较冲击压缩热材料与环境参考材料的XRD信号时，考虑热阻尼效应。

papers.title: Helical Domain-Wall-Ring Networks Reshape Superconducting Correlations
papers.abstract: Extended domain-wall networks emerging in moiré materials provide a distinct platform for quasi-one-dimensional electronic states. However, the interaction-driven orders in confined networks remain largely unexplored. Here, we discuss superconducting (SC) correlations in interacting helical domain-wall-ring networks that emerge in the closed topological domains formed within the moiré patterns of an underlying twisted bilayer honeycomb lattice. We first analyze the system within the framework of an infinite-size theory and show that inter-ring SC-pair tunneling is renormalization-group relevant and thus enhances SC correlations through inter-ring phase locking. To address finite-size effects resulting from the ring-network geometry, we present a self-consistent variational approach. Our analysis shows that even in the regime where the infinite-size theory predicts strongly-coupled pair tunneling, the induced phase-locking scale remains strongly suppressed. In contrast, the SC scaling dimension continues to decrease with decreasing twist angle and remains insensitive to the pair-tunneling strength, revealing a qualitative mismatch from the infinite-size expectation. This discrepancy demonstrates that ring networks do not simply approach their infinite-size counterparts but can exhibit qualitatively distinct collective behavior. Our study highlights how the interplay of confinement effects and ring-network geometry can reshape SC correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：discuss, framework of an infinite-size theory, self-consistent variational approach, renormalization-group。；研究对象：扭曲双层蜂窝状晶格（twisted bilayer honeycomb lattice）的莫尔超晶格中，由闭合拓扑畴形成的螺旋畴壁环网络（helical domain-wall-ring networks）及其超导关联性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 螺旋畴壁环网络中的超导关联行为与无限大尺寸理论预期存在定性差异：即使理论预测环间库珀对隧穿很强，实际诱导的相位锁定尺度仍被强烈抑制；超导标度维数仅随扭转角减小而降低，对隧穿强度不敏感。这表明环网络不会简单地趋近其无限大极限，而是展现出截然不同的集体行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：螺旋畴壁环网络中的超导关联行为与无限大尺寸理论预期存在定性差异：即使理论预测环间库珀对隧穿很强，实际诱导的相位锁定尺度仍被强烈抑制；超导标度维数仅随扭转角减小而降低，对隧穿强度不敏感。这表明环网络不会简单地趋近其无限大极限，而是展现出截然不同的集体行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于揭示了受限环网络几何结构（而非简单的准一维体系）对超导关联性的重塑作用，并指出了有限尺寸效应与无限大理论预期之间的定性失配。
papers.method_zh: 首先采用无限大尺寸理论框架（重整化群分析）研究环间超导库珀对隧穿的相关性；随后，为处理有限尺寸效应，发展了一套自洽变分方法（self-consistent variational approach）来分析环网络几何结构的影响。

papers.title: Quantum Geometry Driven Finite-Momentum Exciton Fluctuations in Flat-Band Systems
papers.abstract: Quantum geometry is instrumental in stabilizing exotic phenomena in systems ranging from topological insulators to superconductors. In dispersionless flat bands, where the kinetic energy is quenched, the quantum metric emerges as the fundamental driver of macroscopic collective phenomena. Here, we theoretically demonstrate that lattice-geometry-induced flat bands, such as those in kagome and Lieb lattices, provide a fertile platform for realizing a purely quantum-geometry-driven excitonic insulator (EI) phase. By applying an out-of-plane Zeeman field to lift spin degeneracy without spin-orbit coupling, we establish a Ginzburg-Landau framework in which the electron-hole wavefunction-overlap directly maps the flat-band quantum metric onto the macroscopic free energy. This mapping plays a key role in both the EI and the associated superfluid phases, with the coherence length and phase stiffness emerging directly from the quantum metric. Our analysis reveals that under strong interactions, the quantum metric induces a negative effective kinetic coefficient for the amplitude mode. Rather than destabilizing the uniform condensate, this softens the amplitude fluctuations at a finite momentum, giving rise to a finite-momentum superfluid density fluctuation (FMSDF) state. This state is observable as a periodically modulated magnitude of in-plane magnetization fluctuations. Our findings establish a rigorous link between flat-band quantum geometry and dynamic collective excitonic states, with promising pathways for realization in covalent-organic frameworks (COFs).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically demonstrate”、“establish a Ginzburg-Landau framework”、“our analysis reveals”。；研究对象：Kagome晶格和Lieb晶格等几何阻挫导致的平带系统中的激子绝缘体（EI）相及其相关的超流相，特别是由量子几何驱动的有限动量激子涨落。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强相互作用下，平带的量子几何会导致振幅模式的负有效动力学系数，从而软化有限动量下的振幅涨落，产生一种新的“有限动量超流密度涨落（FMSDF）”态，该态表现为面内磁化强度的周期性调制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强相互作用下，平带的量子几何会导致振幅模式的负有效动力学系数，从而软化有限动量下的振幅涨落，产生一种新的“有限动量超流密度涨落（FMSDF）”态，该态表现为面内磁化强度的周期性调制。；创新点：首次严格建立了平带量子几何与动态集体激子态（特别是有限动量超流密度涨落态）之间的直接联系，并指出该现象可在共价有机框架（COFs）中实现。摘要未突出说明与以往平带激子绝缘体理论相比的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体建立了Ginzburg-Landau理论框架，将电子-空穴波函数重叠直接映射到平带量子度量上，并以此分析激子绝缘体相和超流相中的相干长度和相位刚度。

papers.title: Influence of Harris disorder on quantum-critical superconductivity
papers.abstract: In the Hertz theory, a quantum critical metal is described by the coupling of a Fermi surface to fluctuations of a Landau-damped bosonic field $φ$, which may represent either an order parameter or a Higgs field for a transition without symmetry breaking. Scattering from $φ$ produces non-Fermi-liquid behavior in the normal state, while the same fluctuations mediate enhanced Cooper pairing. By the Harris criterion, symmetry-preserving disorder couples most strongly to the coefficient of the $φ^2$ term, locally tuning the system toward or away from criticality. This random mass (``Harris disorder'') leads to a finite density of localized low-energy $φ$ modes even when the fermionic states remain extended and continue to provide Landau damping. We study the onset of pairing mediated by these localized overdamped bosonic modes. Starting from a real-space linearized Usadel equation for the two-particle propagator, we show that the localized bosonic wave functions generate both a spatially random pairing vertex and an effective random potential for Cooper pairs. Numerical solution, a self-consistent Born approximation, and Lifshitz-tail analysis reveal two regimes of the pairing instability. At high temperatures, pairing nucleates compact superconducting puddles on the most localized bosonic modes. At lower temperatures, an extended pairing eigenstate appears, but its transition scale and spatial structure remain strongly affected by mesoscopic correlation effects and enhanced probability of returns to favorable regions of the localized bosonic glue. The resulting distribution of local pairing scales has a power-law tail, in contrast to the stretched-exponential tails of disordered BCS superconductors. This mechanism provides a route to broad gap inhomogeneity and superconducting puddles in quantum-critical metals, and offers an interpretation of STM measurements of the cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：理论描述、数值解、自洽玻恩近似、Lifshitz-tail分析。；研究对象：量子临界金属中由Harris无序（随机质量无序）诱导的量子临界超导电性，具体涉及无序对Landau阻尼玻色子场φ介导的Cooper配对的影响，并关联到铜氧化物超导体的STM测量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Harris无序导致局域化的低能玻色子模式，这些模式通过空间随机的配对顶点和有效随机势诱导超导配对；高温下形成紧凑的超导小滴，低温下出现扩展配对本征态，但转变尺度和空间结构仍受介观关联效应影响，局域配对尺度分布呈幂律尾（而非无序BCS超导体的拉伸指数尾）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Harris无序导致局域化的低能玻色子模式，这些模式通过空间随机的配对顶点和有效随机势诱导超导配对；高温下形成紧凑的超导小滴，低温下出现扩展配对本征态，但转变尺度和空间结构仍受介观关联效应影响，局域配对尺度分布呈幂律尾（而非无序BCS超导体的拉伸指数尾）。；创新点：揭示了Harris无序在量子临界金属中产生超导小滴和宽能隙不均匀性的具体机制，并指出局域配对尺度分布具有幂律尾特征，为解释铜氧化物超导体STM测量提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 从实空间线性化Usadel方程出发，结合数值求解、自洽玻恩近似和Lifshitz-tail分析，研究局域化过阻尼玻色子模式介导的配对不稳定性。

papers.title: INCARBench: A Benchmark for Scientific Configuration in VASP INCAR by Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being integrated into first-principles computational workflows, yet their ability to configure scientific calculations remains poorly understood. Here, we introduce INCARBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on input configuration for the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (VASP) through both configuration generation and repair tasks. Evaluating 19 model configurations reveals substantial capability differences among current frontier models. While several models achieve high semantic and policy accuracy, task-critical correctness remains substantially lower, demonstrating that parameter-level correctness does not necessarily imply scientifically valid configurations. Failure analysis shows that errors concentrate in physically coupled settings involving DFT+$U$, magnetism, and correlated materials, where multiple constraints must be satisfied simultaneously. Repair evaluation further reveals that correcting incorrect settings and preserving already-valid configurations are distinct capabilities, with configuration preservation remaining a major challenge. These findings establish scientific configuration as a measurable capability of large language models and provide a foundation for developing more reliable AI systems for computational materials science.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：benchmark、evaluating LLMs、VASP、configuration generation and repair tasks）；研究对象：论文研究的具体对象是大型语言模型（LLMs）在VASP软件INCAR文件中的科学配置能力，而非特定材料或物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当前前沿大语言模型在VASP输入配置任务中，语义和政策准确性较高，但任务关键正确性显著偏低；参数级正确性并不等同于科学有效的配置。错误主要集中在涉及DFT+U、磁性和关联材料的物理耦合设置中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当前前沿大语言模型在VASP输入配置任务中，语义和政策准确性较高，但任务关键正确性显著偏低；参数级正确性并不等同于科学有效的配置。错误主要集中在涉及DFT+U、磁性和关联材料的物理耦合设置中。；创新点：首次将科学配置（scientific configuration）作为大语言模型的可量化能力进行系统评估，并揭示了配置修复中“修正错误”与“保留已有正确配置”是两种不同能力。
papers.method_zh: 构建了INCARBench基准测试，通过配置生成和配置修复两项任务，评估19种大语言模型在VASP INCAR文件输入配置上的表现，并进行失败分析。

papers.title: Skewness tunes the small-drift record rate of random walks and Lévy flights
papers.abstract: A random walk with small positive drift $μ$ sets new records at a rate $λ(μ)$ that vanishes as $μ\to 0$. For centered steps attracted to a stable law $Y$ with index $1 < α\leq 2$ and positivity parameter $ρ= P(Y>0)$, we find $λ(μ) \sim Kμ^{(1-ρ)/ν}$, $ν=1-1/α$, as $μ\to 0$. The result is exact for Gaussian and strictly stable steps, and extends at the leading-power level to their domains of attraction. The exponent is set by the asymmetry only through $ρ$, sweeping the interval $[1,\,1/(α-1)]$ as the skewness varies. It recovers the Gaussian linear law with slope $\sqrt{2}$ and, for symmetric heavy tails, the power $μ^{α/2(α-1)}$; beyond the stable tail ratio, distributional details enter through the prefactor $K$, which is explicit for strictly stable steps. The result follows directly from one Mellin transform of the harmonic sum in the Spitzer-Baxter identity, which factorizes into a kernel transform and a Riemann $ζ$ factor whose poles deliver at once the leading law, its prefactor, and a correction ladder, unifying diffusive, heavy-tailed, and skewed walks. The same transform also yields the expected maximum, recovering Kingman's heavy-traffic law for queues and Siegmund's corrected-diffusion constant as adjacent poles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：随机游走、Lévy飞行、Mellin变换、Spitzer-Baxter恒等式、解析推导。；研究对象：具有小正漂移的随机游走和Lévy飞行（步长分布属于稳定律吸引域）的破纪录率（record rate）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当漂移μ趋近于零时，破纪录率λ(μ)以幂律形式衰减：λ(μ) ~ K μ^{(1-ρ)/ν}，其中指数由步长分布的非对称性参数ρ（即稳定律中正部分的概率）唯一决定，而前因子K则依赖于分布的具体细节（对于严格稳定步长可显式给出）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当漂移μ趋近于零时，破纪录率λ(μ)以幂律形式衰减：λ(μ) ~ K μ^{(1-ρ)/ν}，其中指数由步长分布的非对称性参数ρ（即稳定律中正部分的概率）唯一决定，而前因子K则依赖于分布的具体细节（对于严格稳定步长可显式给出）。；创新点：首次通过单一解析变换（Mellin变换）统一推导出小漂移下破纪录率的渐近行为，并揭示了其指数仅由稳定律的正部分概率ρ决定（而非完整分布形状），从而将高斯游走的线性律（μ^1）与对称重尾游走的幂律（μ^{α/2(α-1)}）作为特例纳入同一框架。此外，该方法还自然恢复了Kingman的排队论重流量律和Siegmund的修正扩散常数。
papers.method_zh: 利用Spitzer-Baxter恒等式中的调和级数进行Mellin变换，将问题分解为核变换与黎曼ζ函数因子的乘积，通过ζ函数的极点同时得到主导幂律、前因子及修正项序列。该方法统一处理了扩散型、重尾型和偏斜型随机游走。

papers.title: Approximating velocity fields with planted attractors via Neural-ODEs for classification purposes
papers.abstract: In this work, Neural ODEs equipped with a curated collection of equilibrium points have been successfully employed for classification tasks. The planted attractors serve as indicators for the target classes, while the velocity field leveraging the universal approximation capabilities of the architecture shapes the dynamical landscape. This process defines the basins of attraction of the trained model, effectively directing each input (provided as an initial condition) toward its corresponding destination target.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Neural ODEs”（神经常微分方程）、“universal approximation capabilities”（通用逼近能力）等关键词，属于机器学习与动力系统结合的理论与计算方法。；研究对象：论文研究的是用于分类任务的神经网络动力学系统。具体而言，研究对象是神经常微分方程（Neural-ODEs）所定义的“速度场”（velocity field）及其形成的“吸引子盆地”（basins of attraction）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过为神经常微分方程（Neural-ODEs）预先植入一组作为目标类别指示器的平衡点（吸引子），可以成功地将该网络用于分类任务。训练过程塑造了动力景观，使得每个输入（作为初始条件）被其对应的吸引子盆地捕获，从而导向正确的分类目标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过为神经常微分方程（Neural-ODEs）预先植入一组作为目标类别指示器的平衡点（吸引子），可以成功地将该网络用于分类任务。训练过程塑造了动力景观，使得每个输入（作为初始条件）被其对应的吸引子盆地捕获，从而导向正确的分类目标。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据摘要推断，其创新点可能在于将“植入吸引子”这一先验知识与Neural-ODEs的动力学学习能力相结合，为分类任务提供了一种基于动力系统吸引子机制的替代方案。
papers.method_zh: 采用了神经常微分方程（Neural-ODEs）作为核心框架。通过植入一组预先设定的平衡点（planted attractors）作为分类目标，并利用神经网络的通用逼近能力来学习一个速度场，该速度场定义了输入空间中的动力学轨迹和吸引子盆地。

papers.title: A dipolar Bose-Bose mixture of Dysprosium isotopes with controllable interspecies interactions
papers.abstract: We report on the realization of a quantum-degenerate Bose-Bose mixture of 162Dy and 164Dy. Owing to the near-identical mass and polarizability of the two isotopes, the mixture thermalizes efficiently, with evaporation trajectories closely following those of the single-isotope case. Using a broad interspecies Feshbach resonance, we explore a miscible-immiscible transition between the two Bose-Einstein condensates. The tunability of the interspecies interaction, combined with the large magnetic dipole moment of Dy, makes this platform well suited for exploring dipolar effects in ultracold mixtures, including multi-component supersolidity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：realization（实现）、explore（探索）、Feshbach resonance（Feshbach共振）。；研究对象：由镝同位素162Dy和164Dy构成的量子简并玻色-玻色混合物，以及其中可调控的种间相互作用和相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功实现了162Dy和164Dy的量子简并玻色-玻色混合物，并通过宽Feshbach共振调控种间相互作用，观察到了两种玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体之间的混溶-不混溶转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功实现了162Dy和164Dy的量子简并玻色-玻色混合物，并通过宽Feshbach共振调控种间相互作用，观察到了两种玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体之间的混溶-不混溶转变。；创新点：首次实现了镝同位素（162Dy和164Dy）的量子简并玻色-玻色混合物，并利用其大磁偶极矩和可调种间相互作用，为研究超冷混合物中的偶极效应（如多组分超固态）提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备了162Dy和164Dy的量子简并混合物，利用两种同位素近似的质量和极化率实现高效热化，并通过宽种间Feshbach共振调控相互作用，研究混溶-不混溶转变。

papers.title: Atomic-scale theory of robust out-of-plane ferroelectricity in ultrathin films
papers.abstract: Ferroelectricity in ultrathin films, characterized by robust switchable out-of-plane polarization, is key to next-generation nanoelectronics. Although the macroscopic theory of ferroelectricity suggests that ferroelectricity is inevitably suppressed as the film thickness decreases, recent studies have demonstrated robust ultra thin-film ferroelectricity, for certain ferroelectric materials, specifically HfO$_2$-based oxides and bismuth-based oxides. In this work, we develop an atomic-scale theoretical framework for understanding ferroelectricity in this limiting regime. By considering the work function of the termination layers of the film, we find that robust ferroelectricity arises from ``self-polarizing'' and ``switchable role of the termination layer'' effects strongly correlated to the ``characteristic structure.'' This theory also provides further insights on the importance of top electrodes in stabilizing ferroelectricity for this class of materials in the ultrathin limit. This work aims to develop a comprehensive theoretical framework for thin-film ferroelectricity, providing fundamental insights that can guide the design of next-generation nanoscale devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“develop an atomic-scale theoretical framework”、“theory”、“provides further insights”。；研究对象：超薄薄膜中稳健的、可翻转的面外铁电性，具体以HfO₂基氧化物和铋基氧化物为典型材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超薄薄膜中的稳健铁电性源于与“特征结构”强相关的“自极化”和“终止层可翻转角色”效应，该效应由薄膜终止层的功函数决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超薄薄膜中的稳健铁电性源于与“特征结构”强相关的“自极化”和“终止层可翻转角色”效应，该效应由薄膜终止层的功函数决定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于原子尺度的理论框架，通过考虑薄膜终止层的功函数来分析铁电性起源，并探讨顶电极对稳定超薄极限下铁电性的作用。

papers.title: High-quality single crystals of the kagome metals Ni$_3$In and Ni$_3$Sn grown from Pb flux
papers.abstract: The bilayer kagome metal Ni$_3$In has recently attracted attention due to the presence of a flat band located near the Fermi level, which has been associated with unconventional thermodynamic and electronic transport properties [Ye et al., Nat. Phys. 20, 610-614 (2024)]. However, further investigation of the intrinsic properties of this system has been hindered by the lack of large, high-quality single crystals. Here, we report the successful growth of Ni$_3$(In, Sn) single crystals using a Pb-flux technique. By optimizing the growth conditions, competing binary phases can be effectively suppressed, enabling the synthesis of single crystals with dimensions reaching several millimeters. We compare the physical properties of our Pb-flux-grown crystals to previously reported samples prepared by iodine-assisted chemical vapor transport and molecular beam epitaxy as well as to first-principles resistivity calculations. We find a significantly lower electrical resistivity in our crystals, in excellent agreement with calculations of resistivity from electron-phonon scattering, a sizeable non-saturating magnetoresistance, and a reduced Sommerfeld coefficient and magnetic susceptibility compared to previous experimental findings, which are likely related to differences in the Fermi level position. Our results establish Pb-flux growth as a reliable route for obtaining large single crystals of the bilayer kagome metals Ni$_3$(In, Sn) that are suitable for further thermodynamic and spectroscopic investigations of their intrinsic electronic and magnetic properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“successful growth”、“single crystals”、“Pb-flux technique”、“physical properties”、“electrical resistivity”、“magnetoresistance”等，主要涉及晶体生长和物性测量。；研究对象：双层kagome金属Ni₃In和Ni₃Sn单晶。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过优化Pb助熔剂生长条件，成功制备出毫米级尺寸的高质量Ni₃(In, Sn)单晶，其电阻率显著低于此前报道的样品，与电子-声子散射计算高度吻合，并表现出非饱和磁电阻以及更小的索末菲系数和磁化率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过优化Pb助熔剂生长条件，成功制备出毫米级尺寸的高质量Ni₃(In, Sn)单晶，其电阻率显著低于此前报道的样品，与电子-声子散射计算高度吻合，并表现出非饱和磁电阻以及更小的索末菲系数和磁化率。；创新点：首次报道了利用Pb助熔剂法成功生长出大尺寸、高质量的Ni₃(In, Sn)单晶，解决了此前缺乏大尺寸高质量单晶而阻碍本征物性研究的问题，并发现其电阻率与理论计算高度一致，表明该方法适用于进一步研究该体系的本征电子和磁性质。
papers.method_zh: 采用Pb助熔剂法生长单晶，通过优化生长条件抑制竞争二元相；对晶体进行电阻率、磁电阻、索末菲系数和磁化率等物性测量，并与碘辅助化学气相输运、分子束外延制备的样品以及第一性原理电阻率计算结果进行对比。

papers.title: Anomalous charge density wave in a two-dimensional superatomic superconductor
papers.abstract: The spatial modulation of electron density into a wave-like pattern, known as charge density wave (CDW), represents a fundamental quantum state that often coexists with superconductivity, quantum Hall states, axion insulating phases and etc. Conventional CDWs are mediated by longitudinal acoustic phonons, exhibit picometer-scale lattice distortions ($10^{-12}$--$10^{-11}$ m), and typically vanish approaching the atomic limit. Here, we report a series of anomalous CDW behaviors in the 2D superatomic superconductor Au$_6$Te$_{12}$Se$_8$. Remarkably, its CDW is governed by transverse phonons, accompanied by an extraordinarily high real-space displacement of $\sim 4$ Ångström. Furthermore, we observe an exotic dimensional response persisting up to micrometer-scale thickness, a regime where other materials are already considered as bulk. Through liquid helium-temperature transmission electron microscopy, ultrafast pump-probe spectroscopy and transport measurements, we demonstrate a dramatic enhancement of the CDW transition temperature ($T_{\text{CDW}}$) from $<2$ K in the bulk to 110 K in approaching the ``superatomic limit''. Our findings not only reveal novel facets of both CDW and superatomic materials, but the competition between this anomalous CDW and superconductivity opens avenues for exploring unconventional electron-phonon interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“liquid helium-temperature transmission electron microscopy, ultrafast pump-probe spectroscopy and transport measurements”等具体实验手段。；研究对象：二维超原子超导体Au₆Te₁₂Se₈中的反常电荷密度波（CDW）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维超原子超导体Au₆Te₁₂Se₈中，电荷密度波由横声子主导，伴随约4 Å的极高实空间位移，且其转变温度从体相的<2 K显著提升至接近“超原子极限”时的110 K。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维超原子超导体Au₆Te₁₂Se₈中，电荷密度波由横声子主导，伴随约4 Å的极高实空间位移，且其转变温度从体相的<2 K显著提升至接近“超原子极限”时的110 K。；创新点：首次在超原子材料中观察到由横声子介导的CDW，并发现其具有反常的高位移幅度和随厚度减薄而急剧增强的维度响应，挑战了传统CDW在原子极限下消失的认知。摘要未突出说明与超导的竞争机制细节。
papers.method_zh: 液氦温度透射电子显微镜、超快泵浦-探测光谱、输运测量。

papers.title: Magnetic-Free Quantum Interference and Universal Josephson Diode Effect Driven by a Supercurrent Gauge Field
papers.abstract: The Josephson effect, a hallmark of superconducting phase coherence, drives modern quantum technologies. However, Josephson-based quantum interference has hitherto been tethered to magnetic fields, despite phase coherence being a quintessential, intrinsic trait of superconductivity. Moreover, the Josephson diode effect (JDE) is typically viewed as an anomalous phenomenon indicative of broken symmetries in exotic phases of matter. Here, in planar Josephson junctions made with $\mathrm{Bi}_2\mathrm{O}_2\mathrm{Se}$ and bilayer graphene, we demonstrate that the JDE is a missing universal property of the Josephson effect. Simultaneously, we present an all-electric technology that replaces magnetic flux for controlling and measuring supercurrent interference. Central to our approach is a supercurrent gauge field (SGF), generated and amplified through high-kinetic-inductance superconductors and novel device architectures. By establishing the physical equivalence between the SGF and a magnetic field, we eliminate the reliance on external fields in quantum interference and reveal a universal, field-free JDE mechanism with broad implications for detecting broken-symmetry states. Finally, we show that the SGF offers capabilities beyond those of a conventional magnetic field by experimentally demonstrating a magnetic-free, phase-sensitive technique to construct and characterize finite-momentum superconductivity, opening new frontiers for exploring novel phases of matter and superconducting quantum architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate, experimentally demonstrating, planar Josephson junctions made with Bi₂O₂Se and bilayer graphene）；研究对象：平面约瑟夫森结中的超流干涉现象、约瑟夫森二极管效应（JDE），以及超流规范场（SGF）驱动的无磁量子干涉。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 约瑟夫森二极管效应是约瑟夫森效应本身固有的普遍性质，而非仅存在于对称性破缺的奇异相中；通过超流规范场可替代磁场实现无磁超流干涉控制与测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：约瑟夫森二极管效应是约瑟夫森效应本身固有的普遍性质，而非仅存在于对称性破缺的奇异相中；通过超流规范场可替代磁场实现无磁超流干涉控制与测量。；创新点：首次证明约瑟夫森二极管效应是约瑟夫森效应的普遍缺失属性；提出并实现超流规范场与磁场的物理等价性，从而在量子干涉中完全消除对外部磁场的依赖；展示了超流规范场超越传统磁场的能力，即无磁相位敏感技术用于构建和表征有限动量超导态。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备基于Bi₂O₂Se和双层石墨烯的平面约瑟夫森结，利用高动能电感超导体和新型器件结构产生并放大超流规范场，通过全电学技术实现无磁场的超流干涉调控与相位敏感测量。

papers.title: Signatures of unconventional magnetism in the layered metallic ferromagnet LaCrSb$_3$ from ferromagnetic resonance spectroscopy
papers.abstract: LaCrSb$_{3}$ is a metallic ferromagnet with a layered crystal structure demonstrating intriguing electronic and magnetic properties, such as large anomalous Hall effect, strong canting of the spin lattice, and a peculiar spin-reorientation transition. Here, we report the results of the temperature-dependent x-ray diffraction, static magnetization, and in particular electron spin resonance (ESR) and ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) experiments carried out over a wide range of frequencies, magnetic fields, and temperatures. Though x-ray data reveals no structural transition down to 15 K, a strong magneto-elastic coupling is detected across the ferromagnetic transition at $T_{\rm C} \simeq 126$ K. ESR results indicate a presence of the quasi-static short-range correlations extending far above $T_{\rm C}$, which is a typical fingerprint of the low-dimensional magnetism. The frequency-field diagram of the FMR modes mapped below $T_{\rm C}$ strongly suggests presence of two magnetic sublattices in LaCrSb$_{3}$. A quantitative understanding of the FMR excitations was achieved within a phenomenological model of interacting orthogonal ferro- and antiferromagnetic sublattices which was earlier proposed to explain unusually strong spin canting observed by neutron diffraction [E.~Granado et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 89, 107204 (2002)]. The FMR results corroborate this scenario and call for the development of the underlying microscopic model of unconventional magnetism in LaCrSb$_{3}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确报告了温度依赖的X射线衍射、静态磁化、电子自旋共振（ESR）和铁磁共振（FMR）实验的结果。；研究对象：层状金属铁磁体LaCrSb₃，具体研究其非常规磁性、自旋晶格倾斜、自旋重取向转变以及磁子晶格间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过铁磁共振（FMR）实验，证实LaCrSb₃中存在两个磁子晶格（一个铁磁性子晶格和一个反铁磁性子晶格），并验证了此前基于中子衍射提出的正交铁磁-反铁磁子晶格相互作用模型，表明该体系存在非常规磁性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过铁磁共振（FMR）实验，证实LaCrSb₃中存在两个磁子晶格（一个铁磁性子晶格和一个反铁磁性子晶格），并验证了此前基于中子衍射提出的正交铁磁-反铁磁子晶格相互作用模型，表明该体系存在非常规磁性。；创新点：首次利用铁磁共振（FMR）光谱学手段，直接观测并定量解释了LaCrSb₃中两个磁子晶格的激发模式，为之前中子衍射提出的非常规自旋倾斜模型提供了关键的共振光谱学证据。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：变温X射线衍射、静态磁化测量、电子自旋共振（ESR）以及宽频率、宽磁场、宽温区的铁磁共振（FMR）光谱学。理论分析采用了描述正交铁磁与反铁磁子晶格相互作用的唯象模型。

papers.title: Population-based eigenstates of the SU(d) spin-exchange model for high-spin fermions in optical lattices
papers.abstract: We investigate the $\mathrm{SU}(d)$ spin exchange model describing ultra-cold fermionic atoms with spin $s\ge 1$ in a one-dimensional optical lattice. The model emerges from the Fermi-Hubbard model in the strongly interacting regime with one atom in each lattice site. The central result of this work is the systematic construction of SE eigenstates in terms of magnetic sub-level populations. This representation provides a natural description of high-spin fermionic systems, where the underlying $\mathrm{SU}(d)$ symmetry gives rise to extensive degeneracies. We illustrate the usefulness of this framework for deriving effective Hamiltonians for a system weakly coupled to light through spin-orbit interactions, using a second-order Schrieffer--Wolff transformation projected onto the introduced population eigenbasis. These effective models provide a controlled description of the collective spin dynamics and capture the role of population redistribution among different collective spin length sectors induced by interactions. The agreement with the exact Fermi--Hubbard with light coupling dynamics confirms the consistency of the population eigenstates framework as a basis for describing high-spin quantum many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、systematic construction、effective Hamiltonians、second-order Schrieffer–Wolff transformation。；研究对象：一维光晶格中自旋s≥1的超冷费米子所描述的SU(d)自旋交换模型，以及该模型在强相互作用极限下从费米-哈伯德模型涌现的物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统构建了基于磁子能级布居数的自旋交换（SE）本征态，该表示法为描述高自旋费米子体系中的SU(d)对称性导致的简并提供了自然框架；通过投影到该本征基矢上的二阶Schrieffer–Wolff变换，可导出弱耦合光时有效的集体自旋动力学哈密顿量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统构建了基于磁子能级布居数的自旋交换（SE）本征态，该表示法为描述高自旋费米子体系中的SU(d)对称性导致的简并提供了自然框架；通过投影到该本征基矢上的二阶Schrieffer–Wolff变换，可导出弱耦合光时有效的集体自旋动力学哈密顿量。；创新点：提出了基于磁子能级布居数的SE本征态系统构造方法，为描述高自旋费米子体系中SU(d)对称性导致的广泛简并提供了自然表示，并展示了该框架在导出有效集体自旋动力学模型中的实用性。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：从费米-哈伯德模型出发，在强相互作用且每个格点一个原子的极限下导出SU(d)自旋交换模型；通过磁子能级布居数系统构造SE本征态；利用二阶Schrieffer–Wolff变换投影到该本征基矢上，推导有效哈密顿量；通过与精确的费米-哈伯德加光耦合动力学对比验证框架一致性。

papers.title: Irreversibility Enhances Quantum-Enhanced Markov-Chain Monte Carlo
papers.abstract: Detailed balance underlies conventional Markov-chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithms. Yet in classical systems, breaking detailed balance generates irreversible probability currents and can accelerate sampling. Whether irreversibility can similarly enhance quantum MCMC remains an intriguing question. Here we show that irreversibility provides a new route to improving the recent quantum-enhanced MCMC (QEMC), which combines quantum proposals with classical acceptance. By introducing state-dependent proposals that break detailed balance while preserving the target stationary distribution, we develop an irreversible quantum-enhanced Monte Carlo (IQEMC). Guided by Landau-Zener transitions, IQEMC promotes large energy descents from high-energy states while maintaining stable transitions near low-energy states. On spin-glass benchmarks, IQEMC outperforms QEMC without increasing computational complexity and, unlike the annealing baseline, exhibits a spectral gap that increases with system size and annealing speed. These results establish irreversibility as a physically grounded mechanism for enhancing quantum MCMC.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Markov-chain Monte Carlo、quantum-enhanced MCMC、spectral gap、spin-glass benchmarks。；研究对象：量子增强马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（QEMC）算法，以及自旋玻璃（spin-glass）基准系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不可逆性（irreversibility）为提升量子增强马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（QEMC）算法性能提供了新途径：所提出的不可逆量子增强蒙特卡洛（IQEMC）方法在不增加计算复杂度的前提下，在自旋玻璃基准上优于QEMC，且其谱隙随系统尺寸和退火速度增大而增大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不可逆性（irreversibility）为提升量子增强马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（QEMC）算法性能提供了新途径：所提出的不可逆量子增强蒙特卡洛（IQEMC）方法在不增加计算复杂度的前提下，在自旋玻璃基准上优于QEMC，且其谱隙随系统尺寸和退火速度增大而增大。；创新点：首次将经典系统中通过破坏细致平衡加速采样的不可逆性机制引入量子增强MCMC，并基于Landau-Zener跃迁设计状态依赖提议，实现了不可逆量子增强蒙特卡洛（IQEMC）算法。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值基准测试。具体包括：引入破坏细致平衡（detailed balance）的状态依赖提议（state-dependent proposals），结合Landau-Zener跃迁（Landau-Zener transitions）指导提议设计，并在自旋玻璃基准上进行性能对比。

papers.title: Dissociation of NaCl in supercritical aqueous fluids of moderate and high concentrations: A molecular dynamics study
papers.abstract: We report classical molecular dynamics simulations of NaCl association and dissociation in supercritical aqueous fluids over a wide range of salt concentrations, from moderate salinity to highly concentrated H2O-NaCl mixtures attainable at high temperatures. The degree of dissociation a and the corresponding ideal dissociation constant Kd, derived directly from a, were calculated as functions of the stoichiometric NaCl mole fraction at selected pressure-temperature (PT) conditions from 673.15 to 1273.15 K and from 0.1 to 2 GPa. At moderate salinity corresponding to a molality of approximately 1 mol/kg, NaCl remains largely dissociated a = 0.3-0.7 depending on pressure and temperature). In contrast, when the mole fraction of NaCl increases up to xNaCl = 0.333 (27.8 mol/kg), the degree of dissociation tends towards zero, and most ions form Na$^+$Cl$^-$ contact pairs and multi-ion clusters. As a result of these competing trends, the mole fraction of structurally dissociated Na$^+$ and Cl$^-$ ions is a non-monotonic function of the stoichiometric NaCl concentration and typically reaches a maximum at xNaCl = 0.06-0.10. This result shows that increasing salinity does not necessarily increase the abundance of structurally available chloride ions in supercritical aqueous fluids. Additional fixed density simulations at 1 and 7 mol/kg extend the analysis up to 1673.15 K and separate the effects of temperature and density on the associate/dissociate state of the ions. The obtained concentration dependences provide molecular-level constraints for thermodynamic descriptions of concentrated supercritical electrolytes and for evaluating chloride availability in high-temperature aqueous fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：classical molecular dynamics simulations（经典分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：超临界水溶液中NaCl的缔合与解离行为，涵盖中等浓度到高浓度（摩尔分数最高至0.333，即27.8 mol/kg）的H₂O-NaCl混合体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NaCl在超临界水溶液中的解离度随盐浓度增加而单调下降，但结构上解离的Na⁺和Cl⁻离子的摩尔分数随浓度呈非单调变化，在x_NaCl = 0.06–0.10处达到最大值。这表明增加盐度并不一定增加超临界水溶液中可用的氯离子丰度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NaCl在超临界水溶液中的解离度随盐浓度增加而单调下降，但结构上解离的Na⁺和Cl⁻离子的摩尔分数随浓度呈非单调变化，在x_NaCl = 0.06–0.10处达到最大值。这表明增加盐度并不一定增加超临界水溶液中可用的氯离子丰度。；创新点：系统揭示了从中等盐度到极高盐度（接近高温下可达到的极限浓度）范围内NaCl解离行为的浓度依赖性，并发现解离离子摩尔分数的非单调行为，为超临界浓电解质的热力学描述和高温水溶液中氯离子可用性的评估提供了分子尺度的约束。
papers.method_zh: 采用经典分子动力学模拟，直接计算解离度α及由此导出的理想解离常数K_d。模拟覆盖温度673.15–1273.15 K、压力0.1–2 GPa，并额外在固定密度条件下（1和7 mol/kg）将温度扩展至1673.15 K，以分离温度和密度对离子缔合/解离状态的影响。

papers.title: Degeneracy-reshaped spin squeezing in high-spin Fermi-Hubbard systems weakly coupled to light
papers.abstract: We study spin squeezing in strongly interacting high-spin Fermi-Hubbard systems weakly coupled to light. We show that spin squeezing dynamics is qualitatively modified by the degeneracies associated with the internal spin structure. We identify these degeneracies as the microscopic origin of the breakdown of conventional maximal-spin description and develop an effective framework based on population eigenstates that quantitatively reproduces spin squeezing evolution. Our results uncover a generic mechanism by which degeneracy reshapes collective spin dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study, show, develop, framework, reproduces（均为理论分析或数值模拟用语，无实验或计算细节描述）。；研究对象：弱耦合到光场的强相互作用高自旋费米-哈伯德体系中的自旋压缩现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高自旋费米-哈伯德系统中与内部自旋结构相关的简并性会定性改变自旋压缩动力学，并导致传统最大自旋描述的失效；基于布居本征态的有效框架可定量复现自旋压缩演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高自旋费米-哈伯德系统中与内部自旋结构相关的简并性会定性改变自旋压缩动力学，并导致传统最大自旋描述的失效；基于布居本征态的有效框架可定量复现自旋压缩演化。；创新点：揭示了简并性重塑集体自旋动力学这一普适机制，并指出传统最大自旋近似在高自旋系统中的根本性失效。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过识别简并性作为微观起源，建立基于布居本征态的有效理论框架，用于定量描述自旋压缩动力学。

papers.title: Reactive Force Field for P/Sn/I System: Atomistic Insight into the Early Stage of Black Phosphorus and Phosphorene Synthesis Process
papers.abstract: Black phosphorus and its two dimensional counterpart, phosphorene, are typically synthesized through chemical vapor transport using Sn and I2 additives. Chemical vapor deposition synthesis of phosphorene and allotropes is still yet not well understood. Investigating the atomistic mechanisms underlying phosphorus transport and early stage processes is difficult experimentally. In this study, a reactive force field for the PSnI system was developed and applied using ReaxFF based molecular dynamics to explore the early stage phase of the pre nucleation relevant to BP-phosphorene growth. The force field parameters were trained on a comprehensive quantum mechanical dataset covering bond dissociation, angle and torsion profiles, and tin condensed phase equation of state and cluster formation energies, showing strong agreement in both gas and condensed phases. We demonstrate that iodine and density together control phosphorus recombination. Under low density, atomic phosphorus dominates with minimal clustering. Adding I2 greatly increases P-P recombination, promotes the formation of PxIy motifs, and transient SnxPyIz compounds. Higher density systems favor the formation of larger Px clusters and support the development of ternary SnxPyIz compounds that grow by capturing transported phosphorus. At the highest density, the system produces condensed, Hittorf like phosphorus structures at the edges of SnxPyIz clusters, along with BP-like hexagons stabilized by iodine that may act as nucleation seeds.
